summary: Global APP_GUARD order is Throttler -> BusinessScopeGuard -> FeatureGuard; JwtAuthGuard is only controller-level, so FeatureGuard always runs before request.user exists and falls back to ?businessId= / :businessId from the URL (feature.guard.ts:112-119). Any caller can pass the id of a premium tenant to bypass @RequireFeature paywall (audit, promotions, loyalty, online_store).
fix: Register JwtAuthGuard as the FIRST APP_GUARD (with a @Public() opt-out), then Feature/BusinessScope guards; in FeatureGuard read businessId only from request.user and never from params/query.
status_note: JwtAuthGuard is APP_GUARD before Roles/BusinessScope/Feature guards (verified in app.module.ts); FeatureGuard reads businessId only from request.user

summary: Because FeatureGuard runs before JwtAuthGuard, request.user is undefined for every normal authenticated request; the web client never sends businessId, so all class-level @RequireFeature controllers (audit.controller.ts:23, promotions.controller.ts:37, loyalty.controller.ts:35) answer 403 'Business context not found' for legitimate users.
fix: Same fix as the guard-ordering finding: authenticate globally first, or apply FeatureGuard via @UseGuards after JwtAuthGuard.
status_note: guard order fixed globally; FeatureGuard uses request.user.businessId only

summary: validate() accepts any token signed with JWT_SECRET and never checks a purpose claim. The 5-minute MFA token (login.use-case.ts:77-85, auth.service.ts:160-169) carries sub/businessId/role and works as a full access token, so knowing the PIN is enough to skip TOTP.
fix: Sign purpose tokens with a separate secret or audience; in validate(), reject payloads that have a purpose and require businessId and role.
status_note: purpose tokens use derived secrets (PurposeTokenService); toAuthUser rejects purpose claim

summary: The email-verification token (auth.service.ts:262-267: {sub, purpose}, valid 24h, obtained by anyone via open registration) passes validate() with businessId=undefined. Prisma drops undefined filters, so where:{businessId:user.businessId} returns rows from every tenant, and verifyOutletAccess-style checks pass for any outlet.
fix: Reject tokens without businessId/role or with a purpose claim; add a Prisma middleware that throws when a tenant filter is undefined.
status_note: toAuthUser requires sub/businessId/role and rejects purpose tokens; strictWhere middleware

summary: No revocation or refresh: validate() never re-checks employee.isActive, role, or businessId. Deactivated or demoted employees keep full access until the JWT expires (JWT_EXPIRES_IN, 7d in docker-compose).
fix: Look up the employee (cached) in validate(), reject inactive users and use the current role; add a token version or jti denylist and shorter-lived access tokens with refresh.
status_note: JwtStrategy re-checks isActive/role/businessId (60s cache); JWT_EXPIRES_IN capped at 7d in env validation

summary: When BusinessScopeGuard runs before JwtAuthGuard, it verifies the bearer token itself and sets request.user from any JWT, including MFA and email-verification purpose tokens. It also skips the checks jwt.strategy would add later.
fix: Remove the in-guard JWT decoding once JWT auth is global; otherwise reject tokens with a purpose claim or without businessId.
status_note: BusinessScopeGuard no longer decodes JWT; relies on request.user

summary: WebSocket handshake uses jwtService.verify() with no purpose, isActive, or businessId check, so the MFA token gives KDS socket access before TOTP. The email-verification token connects with businessId undefined. The same pattern is in notifications.gateway.ts:226. The CORS origin is the raw CORS_ORIGIN string, not split on commas.
fix: Share one token-validation helper with the HTTP strategy (reject purpose tokens, require businessId, check isActive) and split CORS_ORIGIN.
status_note: KDS socket auth goes through toAuthUser (rejects purpose tokens / missing businessId); CORS origins split on commas

summary: Notifications socket accepts any JWT signed with JWT_SECRET, including MFA-pending and email-verification tokens, and then joins business/outlet rooms based on payload.businessId.
fix: Validate the purpose claim and required fields as in the HTTP strategy; disconnect on token expiry.
status_note: socket auth via toAuthUser (rejects purpose tokens, requires businessId) - already in place, verified

summary: Owner bypasses every @Roles check, including routes meant for super_admin only, so super_admin cannot be expressed as a platform-level role. It also crashes with a TypeError (500) if the guard is ever used without JwtAuthGuard, because user is undefined.
fix: Remove the blanket owner bypass for platform-scoped routes (use an explicit @PlatformAdmin), and return false when request.user is missing.
status_note: RolesGuard: owner bypass excludes @Roles('super_admin'); returns false without user

summary: POST /devices/versions lets any tenant OWNER publish a GLOBAL AppVersion with an arbitrary downloadUrl (IsString, not IsUrl) and forceUpdate=true. devices.service.ts:213-258 then pushes an update notification to every active device of that platform across ALL tenants. This can distribute a malicious app.
fix: Restrict it to a platform-admin role outside tenant auth, validate downloadUrl with @IsUrl and a host allowlist, and never let tenant roles write global rows.
status_note: POST /devices/versions @Roles(super_admin) only; downloadUrl @IsUrl https; version semver

summary: Device register/sync/deactivate/update-ack have no @Roles, so any role (cashier, kitchen) can register or deactivate devices of the business.
fix: Add @Roles(OWNER, MANAGER) to the mutating device routes.
status_note: register/deactivate @Roles(owner,manager); sync/update-ack @AllowAnyRole (device self-report)

summary: DELETE /employees/:id does not call canManageRole. A MANAGER can deactivate the OWNER, other managers, or themselves (updateEmployee has the check, delete does not).
fix: Apply the same canManageRole(user.role, employee.role) check and forbid self-deactivation.
status_note: deactivate uses canManageRole, forbids self, tenant-scoped updateMany, audit-logged

summary: POST /employees/:id/shifts/start and /:id/shifts/end allow CASHIER/SUPERVISOR to start or end ANY employee's shift in the business with an arbitrary closingCash, with no outlet enforcement. A cashier can close a colleague's shift and set the cash count, which hides cash differences.
fix: Allow only self (id === user.employeeId) for cashier; managers only within their outlet (OutletAccessGuard.enforceOutletAccess); audit-log shift end on behalf of others.
status_note: per-employee shift start/end: self, or supervisor+ outranking target within own outlet; end-on-behalf audit-logged

summary: POST /:id/attendance/clock-in and clock-out have no @Roles and no self check, so any employee can clock in or out other employees (clock-in also skips outlet enforcement). This enables attendance fraud.
fix: Allow self only, or manager within their outlet.
status_note: clock-in/out @AllowAnyRole with self-or-supervisor+ (own outlet) check

summary: GET /:id/shifts and GET /:id/attendance have no @Roles, so a cashier or kitchen user can read other employees' shift cash differences and attendance in the same outlet.
fix: Restrict to self or manager+.
status_note: GET :id/shifts and :id/attendance: self or manager+ within outlet

summary: verifyOutletAccess only checks the business, so a MANAGER assigned to outlet A can read shift, commission, attendance, and schedule summaries of outlet B (lines 181, 192, 202, 216).
fix: Also call OutletAccessGuard.enforceOutletAccess(user, outletId).
status_note: report endpoints use TenantAccessService.assertOutlet + enforceOutletAccess

summary: OutletFeatureController has only JwtAuthGuard, no RolesGuard. Any cashier or kitchen user can toggle outlet features and call PUT /outlet/:id/type (line 144), which deactivates ALL outletProducts and tables of the outlet and re-applies a template.
fix: Add RolesGuard with @Roles(OWNER, MANAGER) on the PUT routes; require confirmation for destructive type changes.
status_note: outlet feature toggle and outlet type PUTs @Roles(owner,manager); TenantAccessService.assertOutlet

summary: PUT /business/type (destructive: deactivates outlet products and tables, resets features, applies a template) is allowed for MANAGER.
fix: Restrict to OWNER.
status_note: PUT /business/type @Roles(owner)

summary: MANAGER can update business profile and arbitrary settings JSON (line 54), create outlets (80), and deactivate outlets (201), all owner-level actions.
fix: Restrict business-level and outlet create/delete to OWNER.
status_note: business profile/settings, outlet create/delete (and isActive toggle) owner-only; managers restricted to own outlet for outlet-level edits

summary: POST /onboarding/setup can be re-run at any time by a MANAGER. It changes business profile/type (destructive), payment methods, and creates employees. POST /dismiss (line 26) has no role restriction.
fix: Owner only, and reject once guidedSetupCompleted is set.
status_note: setup owner-only, 409 once guidedSetupCompleted; dismiss owner/manager/super_admin

summary: POST /auth/mfa/verify has no specific @Throttle and no per-account attempt counter. With the global 20 req/s and a fresh mfaToken from each re-login, a 6-digit TOTP (3 valid codes per window) can be brute-forced. There is also no replay protection for a used code.
fix: Add a strict throttle, a per-employee failure counter/lockout, and store the last used TOTP step to prevent replay.
status_note: /auth/mfa/verify @Throttle 5/min + per-employee Redis lockout with backoff + used-code replay guard

summary: No per-account lockout on failed PIN; the only protection is 5/min per IP (and without trust proxy all clients share the proxy IP). A 6-digit PIN can be brute-forced from many IPs.
fix: Add a per-account failure counter with backoff/lockout and alerting.
status_note: LoginAttemptService (Redis): per-account lockout after 5 PIN failures, exponential backoff, 429 ACCOUNT_LOCKED

summary: validateOAuthUser links a Google identity to the FIRST active employee with that email (findFirst, no businessId, email not unique across tenants) and does not check Google's email_verified claim. An employee record another tenant created with the victim's email can capture the victim's Google login, or the reverse.
fix: Require payload.email_verified, enforce global email uniqueness (or tenant selection), and only link after the user proves ownership (logged-in linking flow).
status_note: Google login requires email_verified; e-mail must match exactly one active employee (case-insensitive); never re-links an account with another googleId

summary: Disabling MFA needs only a current TOTP, not the PIN. A stolen session plus the device is enough, and there is no audit log entry.
fix: Require PIN re-auth for MFA disable and audit-log it.
status_note: MFA disable requires TOTP + PIN, lockout-counted, audit-logged (MFA_ENABLED/MFA_DISABLED)

summary: PUT /auth/change-pin has no specific throttle; a stolen token can brute-force currentPin at the global rate (20/s).
fix: Add @Throttle and a failure counter.
status_note: change-pin @Throttle 5/min + per-account lockout

summary: PUT /business/type takes dto.outletId without checking ownership. business-type.service.ts:139-146 then deactivates ALL outletProducts and tables of that (foreign) outlet, deletes and re-seeds its outletFeatures, updates its outletType, and applyTemplate creates products and tables tied to it.
fix: Verify outletId belongs to user.businessId (findFirst where {id, businessId}) before any write; use @IsUUID.
status_note: outletId @IsUUID + assertOutlet in controller + findFirst {id,businessId} in service tx

summary: POST /templates/apply passes dto.outletId unchecked to applyTemplate, which creates outletProducts and tables (templates.service.ts:181-213) in another tenant's outlet.
fix: Verify outlet ownership before applying.
status_note: templates/apply assertOutlet + outlet ownership re-checked inside applyTemplateData

summary: createEmployee stores dto.outletId without checking it belongs to user.businessId. The employee's JWT then carries a foreign outletId (login.use-case.ts:57), and outlet-scoped endpoints treat the employee as belonging to that outlet.
fix: Validate outlet ownership, and for managers restrict to their own outlet.
status_note: create verifies outlet via TenantAccessService; non-owners limited to own outlet

summary: updateEmployee accepts dto.outletId without ownership validation (same impact as create).
fix: Validate outletId belongs to user.businessId.
status_note: update verifies outletId same way

summary: Employee email is not unique (schema has no unique index) and create/update (line 293) never check for duplicates, while login and OAuth use a global findFirst by email. A tenant can create an employee with a victim's email, making the victim's login ambiguous (DoS) or routing OAuth to the attacker tenant.
fix: Enforce a global unique index on lower(email) (or a composite with login tenant selection), and reject duplicates on create/update/onboarding.
status_note: case-insensitive duplicate active email -> 409 on create/update; DB unique index handed off

summary: StartShift never checks input.outletId belongs to the employee's business (from shifts/start employees.controller.ts:349 and :id/shifts/start :456). A shift can be opened on another tenant's outlet. Because of the 'another employee already has an open shift at this outlet' rule, this also blocks that tenant's cashiers (DoS).
fix: Load the outlet with where {id, businessId: employee.businessId} and enforce the user's own outlet for non-owner roles.
status_note: StartShift requires businessId and verifies outlet {id,businessId}; controllers also assertOutletUsable

summary: clockIn passes dto.outletId unverified into employeeAttendance.create, so an attendance row can be tied to a foreign outlet (attendance summaries filter by outletId).
fix: Verify outlet ownership.
status_note: clock-in outlet verified (tenant + own outlet)

summary: updateSchedule finds and updates schedule by id only; the controller (employees.controller.ts:534) only validates new employeeId/outletId, not that the existing schedule belongs to the caller's business. Cross-tenant schedule edit.
fix: Load with where {id, outlet: {businessId}} (or employee.businessId) and 404 otherwise.
status_note: updateSchedule findFirst {id, employee:{businessId}, outletId scope}

summary: deleteSchedule deletes by id with no business scope (controller employees.controller.ts:554 ignores user). Any manager can delete other tenants' schedules.
fix: Scope by businessId before delete (deleteMany where {id, employee:{businessId}}).
status_note: deleteSchedule deleteMany scoped + count check

summary: GET /devices/:id returns any tenant's device (findUnique by id, prisma-device.repository.ts:21).
fix: Query with {id, businessId: user.businessId}.
status_note: GET /devices/:id scoped by businessId

summary: PUT /devices/:id/sync updates any tenant's device by id.
fix: Scope update by businessId.
status_note: sync updateMany {id,businessId} + 404

summary: DELETE /devices/:id deactivates any tenant's device by id.
fix: Scope by businessId.
status_note: deactivate updateMany {id,businessId} + 404

summary: GET /devices/:id/update-check reads and updates lastActiveAt of any tenant's device (devices.service.ts:124-136).
fix: Pass user.businessId and scope the lookup.
status_note: update-check scoped by businessId

summary: POST /devices/:id/update-ack sets appVersion on any tenant's device (devices.service.ts:177-191).
fix: Scope by businessId.
status_note: update-ack updateMany scoped + 404

summary: Device register stores client outletId without verifying it belongs to the business.
fix: Validate outlet ownership.
status_note: register verifies outletId via TenantAccessService

summary: Printer config create/update (line 574) store dto.outletId without checking ownership (the value is persisted in business settings JSON).
fix: Validate outletId belongs to user.businessId.
status_note: printer outletId verified via TenantAccessService.assertOutlet on create/update

summary: getAccessibleOutletId returns the owner-supplied outletId without verifying it belongs to the business; safe only if every caller also filters by businessId (not enforced).
fix: Make the helper async and validate, or document that callers must add a businessId filter.
status_note: documented contract (callers must add businessId filter) and deprecated in favour of TenantAccessService.resolveOutletIds; kept sync to not break other callers

summary: Inline @Body type (startShiftForEmployee body {outletId, openingCash}: negative/NaN openingCash accepted); ValidationPipe skips inline types, so forbidNonWhitelisted/whitelist do nothing.
fix: Reuse StartShiftDto/EndShiftDto classes.
status_note: startShiftForEmployee uses StartShiftDto

summary: Inline @Body type (endShiftForEmployee body {closingCash, notes}: closingCash unvalidated (string/negative)); ValidationPipe skips inline types, so forbidNonWhitelisted/whitelist do nothing.
fix: Reuse StartShiftDto/EndShiftDto classes.
status_note: endShiftForEmployee uses EndShiftDto

summary: Inline @Body type, so ValidationPipe skips it: PUT settings/business incl. settings: Record<string,unknown> which overwrites arbitrary business.settings JSON (payment methods, printers, onboarding flags); email not IsEmail.
fix: Replace with class DTOs with @IsNumber/@Min/@Max/@MaxLength/@ValidateNested(+@Type), and whitelist the settings JSON keys.
status_note: UpdateBusinessDto (IsEmail/MaxLength); settings JSON whitelisted to brandColor (hex) and merged under row lock

summary: Inline @Body type, so ValidationPipe skips it: POST settings/outlets (taxRate/serviceCharge unbounded, code >20 chars -> DB error).
fix: Replace with class DTOs with @IsNumber/@Min/@Max/@MaxLength/@ValidateNested(+@Type), and whitelist the settings JSON keys.
status_note: CreateOutletDto with Min/Max rates, code MaxLength(20); P2002 -> 409

summary: Inline @Body type, so ValidationPipe skips it: POST modifier-groups (modifiers[].price can be negative/non-number, min>max).
fix: Replace with class DTOs with @IsNumber/@Min/@Max/@MaxLength/@ValidateNested(+@Type), and whitelist the settings JSON keys.
status_note: CreateModifierGroupDto with nested ModifierInputDto (price>=0), min<=max check

summary: Inline @Body type, so ValidationPipe skips it: PUT modifier-groups/:id.
fix: Replace with class DTOs with @IsNumber/@Min/@Max/@MaxLength/@ValidateNested(+@Type), and whitelist the settings JSON keys.
status_note: UpdateModifierGroupDto

summary: Inline @Body type, so ValidationPipe skips it: POST loyalty (amountPerPoint 0/negative -> divide-by-zero in point calc).
fix: Replace with class DTOs with @IsNumber/@Min/@Max/@MaxLength/@ValidateNested(+@Type), and whitelist the settings JSON keys.
status_note: CreateLoyaltyProgramDto amountPerPoint>=1 (divisor)

summary: Inline @Body type, so ValidationPipe skips it: PUT loyalty (passed straight through as dto).
fix: Replace with class DTOs with @IsNumber/@Min/@Max/@MaxLength/@ValidateNested(+@Type), and whitelist the settings JSON keys.
status_note: UpdateLoyaltyProgramDto; explicit fields passed to repo

summary: Inline @Body type, so ValidationPipe skips it: POST loyalty/tiers (pointMultiplier negative).
fix: Replace with class DTOs with @IsNumber/@Min/@Max/@MaxLength/@ValidateNested(+@Type), and whitelist the settings JSON keys.
status_note: CreateLoyaltyTierDto pointMultiplier 0.01..100, benefits bounded

summary: Inline @Body type, so ValidationPipe skips it: PUT loyalty/tiers/:id (dto passed straight to repo).
fix: Replace with class DTOs with @IsNumber/@Min/@Max/@MaxLength/@ValidateNested(+@Type), and whitelist the settings JSON keys.
status_note: UpdateLoyaltyTierDto; explicit fields, business-scoped update

summary: Inline @Body type, so ValidationPipe skips it: PUT outlets/:id/tax (taxRate unbounded).
fix: Replace with class DTOs with @IsNumber/@Min/@Max/@MaxLength/@ValidateNested(+@Type), and whitelist the settings JSON keys.
status_note: UpdateOutletTaxDto rates 0..100

summary: Inline @Body type, so ValidationPipe skips it: PUT outlets/:id/receipt (logoUrl any string).
fix: Replace with class DTOs with @IsNumber/@Min/@Max/@MaxLength/@ValidateNested(+@Type), and whitelist the settings JSON keys.
status_note: UpdateLegacyReceiptTemplateDto logoUrl IsUrl(http/https), MaxLength

summary: Inline @Body type, so ValidationPipe skips it: PUT outlets/:id/hours array body (dayOfWeek/time unvalidated).
fix: Replace with class DTOs with @IsNumber/@Min/@Max/@MaxLength/@ValidateNested(+@Type), and whitelist the settings JSON keys.
status_note: ParseArrayPipe(items: LegacyOperatingHoursEntryDto) with HH:mm + dayOfWeek 0..6, one per day

summary: Inline @Body type, so ValidationPipe skips it: PUT payment-methods array body (processingFee unbounded).
fix: Replace with class DTOs with @IsNumber/@Min/@Max/@MaxLength/@ValidateNested(+@Type), and whitelist the settings JSON keys.
status_note: ParseArrayPipe(items: LegacyPaymentMethodConfigDto); percentage fee <=100

summary: POST /devices inline body: deviceType/platform enums, deviceName length, and outletId are unvalidated (invalid enum causes a Prisma 500).
fix: Create a RegisterDeviceDto with @IsEnum/@IsUUID/@MaxLength.
status_note: RegisterDeviceDto with IsIn/IsUUID/MaxLength

summary: Webhook bodies typed Record<string,unknown> (midtrans line 62, xendit line 70) bypass ValidationPipe.
fix: Use the existing MidtransWebhookDto/XenditWebhookDto classes.
status_note: subscription webhooks take the raw body via @WebhookPayload and validate an explicit SubscriptionWebhookDto (unknown provider fields stripped, not rejected)

summary: provider is @IsString only; any string is accepted, falls into the Midtrans branch, and is stored in invoice.provider.
fix: Use @IsIn(['midtrans','xendit']).
status_note: provider @IsIn(['midtrans','xendit']); midtrans now 501

summary: getSuspiciousActivities uses raw @Query strings (types enum, outletId, dates) although SuspiciousActivityQueryDto exists (unused). Invalid dates become Invalid Date and cause a Prisma 500. The same applies to list (38-39), getComplianceExport (147-151), and summary (183-184).
fix: Bind the @Query() DTO classes (SuspiciousActivityQueryDto, a ComplianceExport query DTO) with @IsDateString and a max range.
status_note: audit controller binds SuspiciousActivityQueryDto/AuditListQueryDto/AuditEntityQueryDto/ComplianceExportQueryDto; resolveRange validates dates, max 366 days, YYYY-MM-DD as WIB day

summary: CreateEmployeeDto.pin and UpdateEmployeeDto.pin (line 72) have no length or digits rule, so employees can get 1-character PINs (brute-forceable). hourlyRate (50, 89) has no @Min(0); outletId (45, 84) is not @IsUUID; UpdateEmployeeDto.name has no MaxLength.
fix: Add @Matches(/^\d{6}$/), @Min(0), @IsUUID, @MaxLength.
status_note: PIN @Matches 6 digits, hourlyRate @Min(0)/@Max, outletId @IsUUID, MaxLength

summary: StartShiftDto.outletId is IsString, not IsUUID (a non-UUID gives a Prisma 500 with a leaked message); openingCash/closingCash have no @Max.
fix: Use @IsUUID and sensible @Max.
status_note: StartShiftDto outletId @IsUUID, cash @Max

summary: LoginDto.pin has no length/pattern (arbitrary-length strings go to bcrypt) and outletId is not @IsUUID.
fix: Add @Matches(/^\d{6}$/) and @IsUUID.
status_note: LoginDto pin /^\d{4,8}$/ (legacy shorter PINs), outletId @IsUUID, email MaxLength

summary: UpdateProfileDto.profilePhotoUrl accepts any string (javascript:/data: URLs rendered in UI); preferences (line 40) has no @IsObject/size limit and stores arbitrary JSON; name has no MaxLength.
fix: Use @IsUrl({protocols:['https']}), @IsObject with an allowed-keys DTO, and @MaxLength.
status_note: profilePhotoUrl @IsUrl http(s) + MaxLength; preferences = ProfilePreferencesDto whitelist (merged); name Length(1,100)

summary: outletCode has no MaxLength (DB is VarChar(20), so long input gives a 500); phone/businessPhone/address have no length or format validation.
fix: Add @MaxLength(20) and phone validators.
status_note: outletCode Length(1,20)+pattern; phone/businessPhone pattern; address MaxLength

summary: All outletId/employeeId fields are @IsString, not @IsUUID; from/to ranges are unbounded (multi-year report queries); notes have no MaxLength.
fix: Use @IsUUID, cap the date range, add @MaxLength.
status_note: ids @IsUUID, notes MaxLength, ranges capped at 366 days in controller

summary: EmployeeDto: pin is any string (stored in plaintext, see DATA_EXPOSURE), email is IsString not IsEmail, role is accepted but ignored. paymentMethods (86-89) are arbitrary strings, not @IsIn. Business name/phone/address have no MaxLength.
fix: Add @Matches PIN, @IsEmail, @IsIn for methods, @MaxLength.
status_note: PIN 6 digits, IsEmail, IsIn payment methods, MaxLength; role removed (web handoff for 6-digit PIN)

summary: Report schedule recipients are @IsString each, not @IsEmail, with no ArrayMaxSize (same at 411), so reports can be sent to unlimited arbitrary addresses (spam/exfiltration).
fix: Use @IsEmail({}, {each:true}) and @ArrayMaxSize(10).
status_note: recipients IsEmail each, ArrayMinSize 1, ArrayMaxSize 10

summary: Printer ipAddress is not @IsIP; port (304, 347) has no @IsInt/@Min(1)/@Max(65535); outletId (319) is not @IsUUID; PaymentMethod settings (237, 265) is an unvalidated Record.
fix: Add @IsIP, @IsInt range, @IsUUID, @IsObject.
status_note: IsIP, port IsInt 1..65535, outletId IsUUID, payment settings IsObject

summary: UpdateOutletDto/UpdateReceiptTemplateDto/UpdateTaxConfigDto string fields (name, code, header, footer, customMessage, taxName) have no MaxLength; code is globally unique VarChar(20).
fix: Add @MaxLength.
status_note: MaxLength on outlet/receipt/tax string fields

summary: PublishVersionDto.downloadUrl is @IsString (any scheme/host) and is pushed to all devices; DeviceUpdateAckDto.version (88) has no semver check.
fix: Use @IsUrl({protocols:['https']}) with a host allowlist and @Matches semver.
status_note: IsUrl https + semver Matches on publish and ack; host allowlist unnecessary now route is super_admin only

summary: ChangeBusinessTypeDto.outletId is IsString, not IsUUID (and is unverified, see TENANT).
fix: Use @IsUUID and verify ownership.
status_note: ChangeBusinessTypeDto.outletId @IsUUID and verified

summary: getTemplate builds path.join(templatesDir, `${typeCode}.json`) from @Param('typeCode') (templates.controller.ts:26) and the body typeCode (apply-template.dto.ts:30). An encoded ../ (%2e%2e%2f) lets managers read or parse any *.json file on the server (package.json, config files).
fix: Whitelist typeCode against isValidBusinessType() or /^[a-z_]+$/ and check that the resolved path stays inside templatesDir.
status_note: typeCode regex + isValidBusinessType whitelist + resolved path must stay in templatesDir; DTO @Matches

summary: GET /devices/versions is declared after GET /devices/:id (line 68), so Express matches ':id' first. findById('versions') on a UUID column throws, so listVersions is unreachable and returns 500.
fix: Move the static 'versions' routes above ':id', or add ParseUUIDPipe to :id.
status_note: versions routes declared before :id; ParseUUIDPipe on :id

summary: Trial users are rejected by createUpgrade ('use Bayar Sekarang'), but the web 'Bayar Sekarang' button (subscription-page.tsx:233) calls this same /subscription/upgrade, and no other pay endpoint exists. Trial businesses cannot pay until the trial expires and they are downgraded.
fix: Allow upgrade during trial (the new subscription starts at trialEnd or now), or add the missing pay-now endpoint.
status_note: createUpgrade allowed during trial/active/cancelled; period appended to remaining time

summary: activateSubscription expires only 'active'/'trial' subscriptions. After cancel then re-subscribe (allowed because a cancelled row does not block createUpgrade), the old 'cancelled' row keeps its endDate. checkAndExpireSubscriptions (line 522-548) later matches it and downgrades the business to free, although a paid active subscription exists.
fix: In the cron, only downgrade businesses with no remaining active/trial subscription with endDate > now; also expire 'cancelled' rows on activation.
status_note: activation expires all active/trial/cancelled rows; expiry cron downgrades only businesses with no live sub (relation none filter) in one transaction

summary: New subscription endDate = now + 1 month/year. Paying while premium time remains (cancelled-but-active) discards the remaining paid days. Active premium users also cannot renew before expiry (line 159), which forces a lapse to free.
fix: Extend from max(now, current endDate) and allow early renewal.
status_note: new endDate = max(now, current live endDate) + cycle; early renewal allowed

summary: PrismaService is re-provided locally in SubscriptionModule (and AuditModule, audit.module.ts:14) instead of using the global DatabaseModule. Each creates an extra PrismaClient/connection pool and bypasses any shared Prisma middleware.
fix: Remove PrismaService from these providers arrays.
status_note: PrismaService removed from SubscriptionModule and AuditModule providers

summary: csvEscape quotes commas and quotes but does not neutralise leading = + - @ in employee/outlet names or JSON values, so compliance CSVs opened in Excel can execute formulas.
fix: Prefix cells starting with =,+,-,@,\t with a single quote.
status_note: csvEscape prefixes = + - @ tab CR with a quote; applied to every cell

summary: Payment callback marks the invoice paid and activates premium without comparing the paid amount (Xendit paid_amount / Midtrans gross_amount) or currency with invoice.amount. For Xendit, only the static callback token authenticates the request.
fix: Compare amount/currency with the stored invoice and, for Xendit, re-fetch the invoice status from the API before activating.
status_note: paid amount/currency compared with invoice (Decimal); Xendit status re-checked via API when XENDIT_API_KEY set, otherwise 503 retry

summary: The audit IP for LOGIN/UPDATE_PROFILE/CHANGE_PIN (lines 66, 185, 220) is taken from the client-controlled X-Forwarded-For header, so audit trails can be forged.
fix: Set app.set('trust proxy', <hops>) and use req.ip only.
status_note: audit IP = req.ip (honours trust proxy), no raw X-Forwarded-For

summary: End shift reads status=='open', computes, then closes outside any transaction or lock. Concurrent calls (the double-click path via employees.controller.ts:477) both close and publish ShiftEndedEvent twice, and a transaction can land between aggregate and close.
fix: Use a $transaction with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE or updateMany where {id, status:'open'} and check count==1.
status_note: EndShift in one $transaction with conditional updateMany {id,status:'open'} + count check; event after commit

summary: Feature initialisation and trial start run after the business/outlet/employee transaction. A failure leaves a business with no features or trial. The email uniqueness check (line 45) is check-then-act without a DB unique constraint.
fix: Move feature init and trial into the same transaction (pass tx), and add a unique index on email.
status_note: feature init + trial start inside the register $transaction (tx passed to FeatureService/SubscriptionService); e-mail check case-insensitive; unique index handed off

summary: changeBusinessType deactivates outlet data, re-initialises business and outlet features, and applies a template in separate non-transactional steps; a mid-way failure leaves the outlet wiped with no template.
fix: Wrap everything in one interactive $transaction (pass tx to the feature/template services).
status_note: changeBusinessType runs reset+features+template in one interactive tx; tx passed to helpers

summary: initializeFeaturesForBusinessType does deleteMany, createMany, and business.update without a transaction, so concurrent calls or a crash leave the business with no features (FeatureGuard then blocks everything).
fix: Use a $transaction.
status_note: initializeFeaturesForBusinessType in $transaction or caller tx

summary: initializeFeaturesForOutletType does deleteMany, createMany, and outlet.update without a transaction.
fix: Use a $transaction.
status_note: initializeFeaturesForOutletType in $transaction or caller tx

summary: changeOutletType deactivates data, resets features, and applies a template in separate steps with no transaction.
fix: Use a single $transaction.
status_note: changeOutletType single $transaction

summary: guidedSetup calls changeBusinessType (which already applies the template), then calls applyTemplate again (line 197) for the same type, which duplicates categories, products, modifier groups, and tables. The whole flow is non-transactional and can be re-run.
fix: Apply the template once (drop step 3 or skip the template in changeBusinessType), wrap it in a transaction, and make it idempotent.
status_note: template applied once (via changeBusinessType with selected sections); whole setup in one tx; idempotent apply

summary: business.settings JSON is updated read-modify-write without a lock (dismissChecklist 116-131, guidedSetup 241-255, configurePaymentMethods 299-313). Concurrent settings writes (settings controller, onboarding) silently overwrite each other.
fix: Use jsonb_set via $executeRaw, or a transaction with SELECT FOR UPDATE.
status_note: business.settings RMW under SELECT ... FOR UPDATE in tx (dismiss, setup)

summary: clockIn is check-then-create with no lock or unique constraint, so a double submit creates two open attendances.
fix: Add a partial unique index (employeeId where clockOutTime is null) or a transactional lock.
status_note: clockIn in transaction with pg_advisory_xact_lock per employee; partial unique index handed off

summary: Overlap check then create is not atomic, and updateSchedule (line 157) performs no overlap check at all.
fix: Run the check in a Serializable transaction, and add the same check on update.
status_note: overlap check+write in Serializable tx; update re-checks overlap

summary: startTrial is check-then-create plus a separate business.update with no transaction.
fix: Use a $transaction.
status_note: startTrial runs in a $transaction, accepts optional caller tx

summary: applyTemplate is not idempotent; applying twice duplicates the whole catalog (no uniqueness by name).
fix: Skip existing names or require an empty catalog.
status_note: applyTemplate reuses existing categories/modifier groups/products/tables by name

summary: publishVersion is check-then-create for (version, platform) with no unique constraint.
fix: Add @@unique([platform, version]).
status_note: schema already has uq (version,platform); P2002 mapped to 409, check-then-create removed

summary: Suspicious-activity detection filters on action names that are never written ('void_transaction'/'void'/'transaction_void', 'refund'/'refund_transaction', 'create_transaction', 'apply_discount', 'open_cash_drawer'). The real actions are 'transaction_voided', 'transaction_refunded', 'transaction_created', 'cash_in'/'cash_out'. Fraud detection always returns [] and summary suspiciousCount (line 422) is always 0.
fix: Use the actual action constants (centralise them in an enum) and add tests with real log rows.
status_note: detectors use AUDIT_ACTIONS (transaction_voided/refunded/created) actually written; discounts read from transactions

summary: Google 'strategy' is a placeholder: a passport-jwt strategy under the name 'google'. GET /auth/google and /auth/google/callback (auth.controller.ts:105-126) are live and accept a normal bearer JWT; validate maps sub (employee id) to googleId.
fix: Implement passport-google-oauth20 or remove the two routes.
status_note: placeholder GoogleStrategy/GoogleAuthGuard deleted; GET /auth/google(+callback) return 501 pointing to POST /auth/oauth/google

summary: The Midtrans upgrade path charges 'bank_transfer', which returns VA numbers, not redirect_url/actions, so paymentUrl is always null. When a gateway returns success:false (lines 209, 234), the pending invoice is returned without a URL and no error is raised.
fix: Use Snap (redirect) or return VA details, and throw or mark the invoice failed on success:false.
status_note: midtrans upgrade -> 501 (no Snap); gateway success:false or untrusted/missing URL -> invoice failed + 502

summary: Attendance status is always 'present'; lateDays is never computed against schedules; absentDays counts every calendar day including days off.
fix: Compare clock-in time with EmployeeSchedule to set late/absent.
status_note: clock-in status late vs today's schedule (+5 min grace); absentDays = scheduled past days without attendance

summary: Commission rates are hardcoded per role, not configurable per business, but are shown as real payroll figures.
fix: Move them to business settings.
status_note: commission rate overridable via business.settings.commissionRates, constants are defaults

summary: checkAccountCreated always returns true, and checkPrinterConfigured (line 425) treats any 'desktop' device as a printer.
fix: Base the checks on real printer config.
status_note: printer step uses business.settings.printerConfigs; account step checks business exists

summary: The 'units' section is accepted by the DTO but never applied.
fix: Implement it or remove it from the DTO.
status_note: units documented as applied via product sellUnit (flag kept for compat); web handoff to drop checkbox

summary: SuspiciousActivityType FREQUENT_NO_SALE and PRICE_OVERRIDE are advertised in Swagger but not implemented in AuditService.
fix: Implement or remove.
status_note: removed FREQUENT_NO_SALE, PRICE_OVERRIDE and CASH_DRAWER_NO_SALE (no data source); UNUSUAL_DISCOUNT implemented from transactions

summary: handlePaymentCallback catches every error and returns {success:false} with HTTP 200 (controller @HttpCode(200)), so Xendit/Midtrans treat it as delivered and never retry. A transient DB error loses a paid activation.
fix: Rethrow (5xx) on unexpected errors so the gateway retries; keep 200 only for known no-op cases.
status_note: no catch-all; unexpected errors propagate as non-2xx; invalid signature 401, missing ref 400; known no-ops stay 200

summary: The catch-all around applyTemplate treats any error (DB failure, constraint) as 'template not found' and still returns success:true after the outlet was wiped. The same happens in outlet-type.service.ts:143.
fix: Only catch NotFoundException; rethrow others.
status_note: only NotFoundException for missing template tolerated; other errors propagate and roll back

summary: Trial start failure is only logged; the business is created on the free plan silently and the user is told nothing.
fix: Make it part of the transaction or surface the failure.
status_note: trial start failure now aborts registration (same transaction) instead of silent free plan

summary: Audit log write failures are silently ignored with an empty catch (lines 80, 198, 233; also employees.controller.ts:321 for CHANGE_ROLE), leaving no trace that security events were lost.
fix: Log at warn/error level with context.
status_note: auth/mfa audit failures logged at warn with context (employees part handled in employees slice)

summary: GET /audit returns every audit row in the date range with no take (prisma-audit.repository.ts:69), and the range is caller-controlled. GET /audit/entity (line 55) is also unbounded.
fix: Add pagination (page/limit with max) and cap the range.
status_note: GET /audit and /audit/entity paginated (page/limit, max 100), still plain array; range capped

summary: Compliance export and suspicious-activity queries (lines 65, 99, 132, 168, 201) load all matching audit logs into memory with no limit; a multi-year range can exhaust memory.
fix: Stream or batch (cursor) and cap the range.
status_note: detector queries take 50k cap; compliance export counts first and refuses >50k rows; range max 366 days

summary: limit comes from the query (auth.controller.ts:277) with no maximum, so ?limit=1000000 dumps everything.
fix: Clamp limit to at most 100.
status_note: GET /auth/activity uses PaginationQueryDto (limit<=100); use-case clamps too

summary: listEmployees has no pagination.
fix: Add take/skip.
status_note: listEmployees bounded (page/limit, max 500), array shape kept

summary: GET /employees/:id/shifts returns all shifts ever, each including all completed transactions.
fix: Paginate, and use aggregate instead of including transactions.
status_note: employee shifts paged (default 50, max 100); sales via transaction.groupBy instead of include

summary: getEmployeeCommissions returns every transaction in an unbounded date range; getAttendanceRecords (employee-attendance.service.ts:123) is also unbounded.
fix: Cap the range and paginate.
status_note: ranges capped 366 days; commission rows take 2000 (totals via aggregate); attendance take 1000

summary: listVersions and getLatestVersionForPlatform (line 272) load all versions.
fix: Use take / order by semver columns.
status_note: listVersions/getLatestVersionForPlatform take 100

summary: getAllEmployeeShiftSummary runs shift.findMany (with transactions) per employee.
fix: Use a single groupBy/aggregate by employeeId.
status_note: shift summary: one shift findMany + one groupBy

summary: getAttendanceSummary runs a query per employee.
fix: Use one findMany/groupBy for the outlet.
status_note: attendance summary: two queries grouped in memory

summary: getAllEmployeeCommissionSummary runs an aggregate per employee.
fix: Use transaction.groupBy({by:['employeeId']}).
status_note: commission summary: transaction.groupBy by employeeId

summary: bulkUpdateFeatures calls toggleFeature sequentially (each with several queries), and the dependent-feature loop (line 169) calls isFeatureEnabled per dependency. The same applies to outlet-feature.service.ts:148.
fix: Batch with updateMany in one transaction.
status_note: dependent-feature disable batched (findMany+updateMany); bulk capped ArrayMaxSize(100), kept ordered toggles for dependency semantics

summary: Template apply creates categories, modifier groups, products, and tables one query at a time inside the transaction (lines 128, 144, 170, 206), which risks a transaction timeout for large templates.
fix: Use createMany where possible.
status_note: template apply uses createManyAndReturn/createMany batches

summary: The controller injects PrismaService and contains business logic: direct queries (lines 77, 96, 134, 230, 398, 568), bcrypt hashing (131, 300), and money aggregation (419).
fix: Move it into EmployeesService/use-cases.
status_note: controller no longer injects PrismaService/bcrypt; logic moved to EmployeeManagementService

summary: The controller injects PrismaService for the ownership check.
fix: Move it into OutletFeatureService.
status_note: OutletFeatureController uses TenantAccessService, no PrismaService

summary: expectedCash and cashDifference are computed with JS numbers (toNumber, Number()) from Decimal columns.
fix: Use Prisma.Decimal arithmetic.
status_note: EndShift uses Prisma.Decimal via shared computeShiftCash

summary: Shift sales and cash variance are summed as floats (lines 60, 145, 148).
fix: Use Decimal or DB aggregates.
status_note: shift reports sum with Decimal (sumMoney) from DB groupBy

summary: Commission is calculated with float multiplication and Math.round(x*100)/100 (lines 56-66, 116-118).
fix: Use Decimal with explicit rounding mode.
status_note: commission via Decimal, roundRupiah

summary: totalSales is reduced with float addition.
fix: Use a DB aggregate or Decimal.
status_note: totalSales from DB groupBy (Decimal)

summary: 'Today' for the already-clocked-in check uses setHours(0,0,0,0) in server local time, not Asia/Jakarta; record dates (line 132) use the UTC toISOString date.
fix: Compute day boundaries in the outlet timezone (e.g. date-fns-tz).
status_note: clock-in 'today' = startOfBusinessDay; record date = WIB business date

summary: Report ranges use new Date(query.from/to): date-only strings parse as UTC midnight, so Jakarta days are shifted by 7h and the 'to' date excludes the last day (also at lines 205, 219, 510, 600, 647).
fix: Parse dates as outlet-local start/end of day.
status_note: resolveReportRange: YYYY-MM-DD -> WIB day start / inclusive end

summary: The weekly grid mixes UTC-parsed weekStart, server-local setHours/getDay (lines 103, 138), and UTC toISOString keys (121).
fix: Use a single timezone-aware date library.
status_note: weekly grid uses pure UTC date-column arithmetic (getUTCDay, date keys)

summary: After-hours detection uses createdAt.getHours() in server time (UTC in containers), so 07:00-23:00 WIB is judged in UTC. groupByHour (line 504) has the same issue.
fix: Convert to Asia/Jakarta or the outlet timezone before hour checks.
status_note: after-hours and hour buckets use businessHour (WIB)

summary: @Cron jobs (midnight, 09:00, 10:00; lines 21, 37, 106) have no timeZone option, so they run in server time, and reminders arrive at 16:00 WIB.
fix: Pass {timeZone:'Asia/Jakarta'}.
status_note: all subscription crons use timeZone BUSINESS_TZ

summary: Invoice number = count+1 inside a READ COMMITTED transaction. Concurrent upgrades get the same number and hit the unique constraint (uq_invoice_business), which returns a 500.
fix: Use a DB sequence or per-business counter row with an atomic increment, or retry on P2002.
status_note: invoice number via DocumentNumberService (INV-000001 per tenant); gateway reference is invoice.id since numbers are per-tenant; webhook looks up by id (legacy fallback by number, refuses ambiguity)

summary: Outlet code is @unique GLOBALLY (schema outlet.code @unique) but chosen by tenants (register line 71, settings.controller.ts:96, UpdateOutletDto.code). One tenant's 'OTL-001' blocks every other tenant and the duplicate surfaces as a Prisma 500.
fix: Make it @@unique([businessId, code]) and map P2002 to 409.
status_note: schema already @@unique([businessId, code]); GlobalExceptionFilter maps P2002 to 409

summary: There is no app.set('trust proxy'). Behind a load balancer, req.ip is the proxy IP, so ThrottlerGuard's per-IP limits (login 5/min) are shared by all users (DoS, and brute force not per-client).
fix: Set trust proxy to the number of known hops.
status_note: main.ts app.set('trust proxy', parseTrustProxy(TRUST_PROXY)); validated at boot

summary: JWT_SECRET is only checked for presence; placeholder or short secrets (e.g. 'your-jwt-secret-change-this') are accepted in production.
fix: Enforce minimum length/entropy and reject known placeholders when NODE_ENV=production.
status_note: env.validation rejects <32-char/placeholder JWT_SECRET in production (verified)

summary: CORS_ORIGIN silently defaults to http://localhost:5173.
fix: Require it in production.
status_note: CORS_ORIGIN required in production (env validation); localhost fallback only outside production

summary: FRONTEND_URL silently defaults to localhost, so verification links (and OAuth redirects in auth.controller.ts:118) point to localhost in production if unset.
fix: Add it to required env validation.
status_note: FRONTEND_URL required in production; AuthService throws in prod if missing, localhost only in dev

summary: The JWT expiry fallback '8h' here conflicts with main.ts making JWT_EXPIRES_IN mandatory and docker-compose using 7d; the effective lifetime is unclear.
fix: Define one validated config value with an upper bound.
status_note: removed '8h' fallback; JWT_EXPIRES_IN validated (format, <=7d) and read with getOrThrow

summary: expireSubscriptions, sendExpiryReminders (37), and expirePendingInvoices (106) have no distributed lock. With more than one replica, each runs N times (duplicate push notifications, racing downgrades).
fix: Use a Redis/pg advisory lock or run the cron on a single worker.
status_note: all crons wrapped in DistributedLockService.runExclusive

summary: The reminder query matches every sub expiring within 3 days, so owners get the same reminder on 3 consecutive days with no 'already sent' marker.
fix: Record reminderSentAt.
status_note: reminders only when endDate falls in the WIB day exactly 3 or 1 days ahead: one reminder per offset, no schema change

summary: PUT /employees/:id returns employeeRepo.update() output (a full EmployeeRecord) including the pin bcrypt hash, mfaSecret (TOTP seed, plaintext), googleId, and preferences.
fix: Map to a safe response DTO (as getEmployee does).
status_note: update returns explicit safe select/mapper (no pin/mfaSecret/googleId); spec asserts

summary: Guided setup stores the new cashier's PIN in PLAINTEXT (pin: dto.employee.pin, no bcrypt). The employee also can never log in, because login bcrypt.compare()s against it.
fix: Hash with bcrypt (cost 10-12) as elsewhere.
status_note: cashier PIN bcrypt-hashed (cost 10); duplicate email rejected

summary: The TOTP secret is stored unencrypted in employees.mfa_secret, so a DB or backup leak defeats MFA for all users.
fix: Encrypt at rest (AES-GCM with a KMS/env key).
status_note: TOTP seeds encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM (MfaSecretCipher, MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY or JWT_SECRET-derived); legacy plaintext still readable

summary: For non-HttpException errors the raw exception.message (Prisma errors including table/column/constraint details and invalid values) is returned to the client with status 500.
fix: Return a generic message for 5xx and log details server-side only.
status_note: GlobalExceptionFilter: generic message for 5xx, P2002->409/P2025->404 without raw Prisma text; details only logged

summary: The OAuth callback redirects with the access token (and MFA token, line 121) in the URL query string, which leaks through browser history, Referer headers, and proxy logs.
fix: Use a one-time code exchanged via POST, or a URL fragment/httpOnly cookie.
status_note: redirect-with-token callback removed (501)

summary: /uploads is served statically without auth; any uploaded tenant file is public to anyone who knows or guesses the path.
fix: Serve private uploads via a signed-URL or authenticated route.
status_note: /uploads holds product/logo images that storefront/self-order render publicly; private uploads need a signed-URL feature, out of scope

summary: authThrottleConfig is exported but never used.
fix: Remove it or apply it to auth routes.
status_note: unused authThrottleConfig removed; auth routes use explicit @Throttle

summary: RequireAnyFeature/FEATURES_KEY and the multi-feature branch (lines 83-95) are never used.
fix: Remove them.
status_note: RequireAnyFeature/FEATURES_KEY and multi-feature branch removed (no users)

summary: ValidationError is never used (and defaults to code INVALID_PAYMENT).
fix: Remove it.
status_note: ValidationError deleted, errors/index updated

summary: The PaymentMethod, OrderStatus (order-status.ts), and TransactionStatus (transaction-status.ts) enums in shared/constants are never imported; the code uses Prisma enums and string literals.
fix: Remove them or use them consistently.
status_note: unused PaymentMethod/OrderStatus/TransactionStatus enums deleted, constants/index updated

summary: DismissOnboardingDto and OnboardingStepStatusWithCount are unused.
fix: Remove them.
status_note: DismissOnboardingDto and OnboardingStepStatusWithCount removed

summary: SuspiciousActivityQueryDto is unused; the controller reads raw query params.
fix: Bind it in the controller.
status_note: SuspiciousActivityQueryDto bound in controller

summary: AppVersionDto and DeviceUpdateStatusDto (line 67) are unused; minRequired can never be set via the API.
fix: Remove them or wire them up.
status_note: AppVersionDto and DeviceUpdateStatusDto removed (unused)

summary: MfaService.verifyToken is used only by tests.
fix: Remove it or use it in verifyMfaAndLogin.
status_note: MfaService.verifyToken removed (tests updated)

summary: OutletTypeService getAllPresets/getPresetsGrouped/isValidType and BusinessTypeService.getAllTypeCodes (business-type.service.ts:283) are unused.
fix: Remove them.
status_note: OutletTypeService preset helpers and BusinessTypeService.getAllTypeCodes removed (BusinessTypeService getAllPresets/isValidType still used)

summary: EmployeeDto.role is accepted but ignored (always 'cashier').
fix: Remove it or honour it with IsIn validation.
status_note: EmployeeDto.role removed (always cashier)

summary: POST /pos/transactions: for OWNER/SUPER_ADMIN without outletId in token, dto.outletId is used without verifying the outlet belongs to user.businessId (sales can be injected into another tenant's outlet/shift)
fix: Verify outlet.businessId === user.businessId (findFirst {id, businessId}) before executing
status_note: assertOutlet via TenantAccessService; staff forced to their outlet

summary: PosController injects PrismaService and implements listTransactions query building/mapping and outlet ownership lookups directly in the controller
fix: Move to a ListTransactionsUseCase / repository method
status_note: controller thin; list/detail moved to TransactionQueriesUseCase, no PrismaService

summary: GET /pos/transactions query params (page, limit, status, startDate, endDate, outletId, search) are raw strings; invalid status enum or date string reaches Prisma and causes 500
fix: Use a ListTransactionsQueryDto with @IsIn status, @IsDateString, @IsUUID, @Type(()=>Number)
status_note: ListTransactionsQueryDto (@IsUUID/@IsDateString/@Type Number, status CSV whitelisted)

summary: startDate/endDate parsed with new Date(); a date-only endDate becomes UTC 00:00 so lte excludes the whole last day and boundaries are UTC, not Asia/Jakarta
fix: Parse dates as outlet-timezone day start/end (e.g. endOfDay in Asia/Jakarta)
status_note: YYYY-MM-DD parsed as Jakarta business day (endDate inclusive)

summary: paidAmount/changeAmount summed with JS number floats from Decimals
fix: Sum with Prisma.Decimal and convert at the edge
status_note: Decimal sums via @shared/utils/money

summary: POST /pos/transactions/:id/payments body typed inline `{ payments: PaymentDto[] }`; ValidationPipe metatype is Object so nested PaymentDto (method whitelist, amount @Min) is never validated - negative/NaN amounts and arbitrary methods accepted
fix: Create MultiPaymentDto class with @ValidateNested({each:true}) @Type(()=>PaymentDto) @ArrayMinSize(1)
status_note: MultiPaymentDto class with ValidateNested

summary: Refund/multi-payment/reprint only check tx.businessId; a supervisor/cashier assigned to outlet A can refund or add payments to transactions of outlet B in the same business
fix: Also enforce OutletAccessGuard.getAccessibleOutletId(user, tx.outletId) for non-owner roles
status_note: TransactionQueriesUseCase.assertAccess enforces outlet access on refund/payments/reprint/void

summary: GET /pos/held-bills lets a cashier pass any outletId of the same business (only business ownership checked), bypassing outlet assignment
fix: Use OutletAccessGuard.getAccessibleOutletId for non-owner roles
status_note: held-bills resolve outlet (staff forced to own outlet, owners assertOutlet)

summary: POST /pos/hold: owner with no token outletId passes dto.outletId; if user.outletId is set, dto.outletId is silently ignored; HoldBillDto.outletId is required but not UUID-validated
fix: Resolve outlet explicitly and validate with @IsUUID
status_note: hold outlet resolved explicitly; outletId @IsUUID

summary: item.unitPrice from client overrides product/variant price (any value >= 0) with no pos_price_editing feature or role check
fix: Always use server price; allow override only if feature enabled and role authorised, and audit it
status_note: SalePricingService: DB prices; override only with pos_price_editing + role>=supervisor, audit-logged

summary: Bundle price taken from item.unitPrice when provided (client-controlled)
fix: Use bundle.price from DB
status_note: bundle price from DB (override rules as products)

summary: Discounts are client-supplied type/value; fixed discounts of any amount and percentage up to 100% are applied without validating promotionId/voucherCode, promotion validity, min purchase, or cashier permission
fix: Compute discounts server-side from validated promotions/vouchers (PromotionRulesEngine / ValidateVoucherUseCase); manual discounts gated by role/limit
status_note: discounts only from server-validated promotion/voucher (PromotionRulesEngine) or manual within role cap

summary: Shift loaded by id only; not verified to belong to input.outletId/business or the employee, so a sale can be booked into another outlet's or tenant's open shift
fix: Require shift.outletId === input.outletId (and employee match) before proceeding
status_note: shift must be open, in outlet+business; cashier must own the shift

summary: bundlePackage.findFirst by id without businessId: bundles of other tenants can be sold
fix: Add businessId (via outlet.businessId) to where clause
status_note: bundles scoped by businessId

summary: productRepo.findById(productId) without business scope; products of other tenants can be sold and their name/price leak into receipts
fix: Verify product.businessId matches outlet's business
status_note: products scoped by businessId, batch findMany

summary: productVariant.findUnique by variantId without checking variant.productId === item.productId (or business); a cheaper variant of any product/tenant can set the price; unknown variantId silently falls back to base price
fix: findFirst {id: variantId, productId: item.productId}; throw if not found
status_note: variant must belong to product (and business); unknown variant rejected

summary: modifier.findMany by ids without business/product modifier-group scope; unknown ids silently dropped
fix: Restrict to modifiers in groups attached to the product within the business; reject unknown ids
status_note: modifiers must be active in a business group attached to the product; unknown ids rejected

summary: customerId and tableId from client stored without verifying they belong to the business (cross-tenant customer gets loyalty points via TransactionCreatedEvent)
fix: Validate customer.businessId and table.outletId before create
status_note: customer via TenantAccessService.assertOwned; table must belong to outlet

summary: promotion.update({where:{id: promotionId}}) increments usedCount of any promotion id including other tenants', without checking active/usage limit
fix: updateMany with businessId + active + usedCount < usageLimit and assert count===1
status_note: promotion usage via conditional UPDATE scoped by business + usage limit, count checked

summary: voucher.updateMany by code (no businessId) and result count ignored; discount is still granted if voucher was already used / belongs to another tenant, so vouchers can be reused concurrently
fix: Scope by businessId, check returned count===1 inside the transaction, else throw
status_note: voucher updateMany scoped by business, usedAt null, count===1 else sale fails

summary: Payments stored as supplied: credit_note accepted without balance check, non-cash methods (card/qris/ewallet) accepted without gateway confirmation, and change computed even when overpayment is non-cash
fix: Validate credit note balance, require confirmed gateway reference for non-cash, only allow change for cash
status_note: credit_note rejected (no ledger); change only from cash; non-cash rows recorded as cashier-confirmed (EDC/static QR)

summary: receiptNumber = TXN-Date.now()-Math.random; not sequential per outlet (fiscal receipts need gapless sequence) and collision-prone
fix: Use per-outlet sequence table/counter incremented in the transaction
status_note: receipt numbers via DocumentNumberService (per business, daily)

summary: subtotal, discount, tax, service charge, grand total computed in JS floats (e.g. percentage discount not rounded) and persisted to Decimal
fix: Use Prisma.Decimal/integer rupiah with explicit rounding
status_note: all totals Prisma.Decimal, rounded to rupiah

summary: Grand total always rounded to nearest 500 (hard-coded) even for non-cash payments; roundingAmount not persisted, so subtotal-discount+tax+service != grandTotal in DB
fix: Make rounding configurable, apply to cash only, persist rounding column
status_note: rounding now only for all-cash payments; persisting roundingAmount needs schema column (handoff) | resolved via handoff

summary: No idempotency key: retried/duplicated POS submissions (network retry, offline sync) create duplicate transactions and double stock deductions
fix: Accept client idempotency key (unique per outlet) and return existing transaction on replay
status_note: clientTransactionId + occurredAt; replay returns original; P2002 race handled

summary: Per-item queries in loops (product, variant, modifiers, stock level, bundle) and per-item creates/product lookups inside $transaction (lines 330-513)
fix: Batch-load products/variants/modifiers/stock with findMany + createMany
status_note: batched lookups; single nested create; aggregated stock updates

summary: Loyalty points calculation errors swallowed with empty catch (no log); customer looked up by id without business scope

summary: Day boundaries via setHours(0/23:59) in server local time (and cron EVERY_DAY_AT_MIDNIGHT in server TZ); on a UTC server the 'day' is 07:00-06:59 WIB; lt endOfDay excludes the final millisecond

summary: @Query('outletId') is an untyped string with no DTO/ParseUUIDPipe; missing value is not rejected (enables the cross-tenant leak above).
fix: Use a ListOrdersQueryDto with @IsUUID() outletId.
status_note: ListOrdersQueryDto with @IsUUID outletId, @IsIn status, bounded limit

summary: POST /orders accepts outletId from body and forwards it without verifying the outlet belongs to user.businessId; any authenticated user can inject orders into another tenant's KDS (outletId `dto.outletId || user.outletId`).
fix: Verify outlet.businessId === user.businessId (or force user.outletId for outlet-bound roles) before calling the use case.
status_note: POST /orders: assertOutlet(dto.outletId ?? user.outletId) and use case verifies outlet/products/customer/table against businessId

summary: createOrder @Body typed as inline object: ValidationPipe skips it; quantity can be 0/negative/float/string, orderType any string, items unbounded, productId not UUID.
fix: Create CreateOrderDto with @IsUUID, @IsEnum(orderType), @ValidateNested({each}) + @Type(() => OrderItemDto), @IsInt @Min(1) quantity, @ArrayMaxSize, @MaxLength notes.
status_note: CreateOrderDto with nested OrderItemInputDto (@IsUUID, @IsInt @Min(1) @Max(999), @ArrayMinSize/@ArrayMaxSize, @MaxLength)

summary: updateStatus @Body inline type `{status}`; not validated (arbitrary status string reaches use case).
fix: Use UpdateOrderStatusDto with @IsEnum.
status_note: UpdateOrderStatusDto @IsIn (cancel removed from status endpoint)

summary: modifyOrderItems @Body inline type; addItems quantity unchecked (only updateItems has a runtime min check), arrays unbounded.

summary: cancelOrder @Body `{reason}` inline type; reason unvalidated/unbounded, may be undefined -> notes '[CANCELLED] undefined'.

status_note: ModifyOrderDto: priority @IsInt 0..10, quantities >=1

status_note: SetOrderPriorityDto (@IsIn) wired into PUT /orders/:id/priority

summary: DELETE /orders/:id reads reason from @Body inline type (bodies on DELETE are often stripped by proxies/clients) and it is not validated.

status_note: DELETE /orders/:id uses CancelOrderDto; same use case as PUT /:id/cancel (preferred route)

summary: OrdersController uses only JwtAuthGuard, no RolesGuard/@Roles: any role (e.g. kitchen, cashier) can cancel/delete/modify orders and change priority.
fix: Add RolesGuard and @Roles per route (cancel/delete -> supervisor+).
status_note: @Roles on every mutation: front-of-house (+kitchen for status), DELETE supervisor+

summary: PrismaService injected into controller and used directly for outlet ownership check.

summary: Two divergent implementations: PUT /:id/items uses OrdersService.modifyItems and PUT /:id/cancel uses OrdersService.cancel, while PUT /:id and DELETE /:id use ModifyOrderUseCase/CancelOrderUseCase. OrdersService.cancel publishes no OrderStatusChangedEvent (KDS never notified); ModifyOrderUseCase lacks the quantity>=1 check OrdersService has.

status_note: Single implementation: PUT /:id and /:id/items -> ModifyOrderUseCase; /:id/cancel and DELETE -> CancelOrderUseCase; OrdersService.modifyItems/cancel removed

summary: modifyItems looks up products by id without businessId: products of another tenant can be added to an order (name leaked into KDS).

summary: orderItem.create inside loop (and updateMany per item at 133).

summary: orderNumber = 'ORD-'+Date.now().toString(36): two orders in the same ms collide, not per-outlet sequential; Order.orderNumber has no unique constraint.

summary: orderItem.create awaited in a loop per item.

summary: KDS order created from transaction gets a new random ORD- number unrelated to the receipt number, so kitchen tickets can't be matched to receipts.

summary: Failures creating the KDS order (e.g. table occupied -> AppError) are only logged; the paid dine-in order never reaches the kitchen and no one is alerted.

summary: Order update, item updateMany and table update not in a transaction; status check-then-act race.

summary: Table freed by id unconditionally even if currentOrderId now points to another order.

summary: generateOrderNumber uses date (server local tz) + 4 Math.random chars; collisions possible and Order.orderNumber has no unique constraint.

summary: Order number date part uses server-local new Date() instead of Asia/Jakarta/outlet tz.

summary: Unknown orderId format or missing session is only logged; controller still returns {received:true} so the gateway won't retry and errors go unnoticed.

summary: 'today' computed with server-local setHours(0,0,0,0) instead of Asia/Jakarta/outlet tz for daily numbering.

summary: product.findUnique inside loop for every item in autoSubmitToKDS.

summary: autoSubmitToKDS creates order then items one by one without a transaction; separate update calls at 302/308/319 also not atomic.

summary: Redundant second update setting paymentStatus:'failed' after it was already set at line 302.

summary: paymentCallback @Body inline type; status not enum-validated (unknown value just stored as paymentStatus).

summary: Duplicate webhook route POST /self-order/payment-callback (alt path) with a different body shape; sessionCode field ignored.

summary: paymentCallbackAlt @Body inline type, not validated.

status_note: SelfOrderPaymentCallbackAltDto

summary: POST /self-order/menu/translations (JWT only) reads and overwrites product.description by productId with no businessId check: any logged-in user of any tenant can rewrite other tenants' product descriptions.

status_note: products loaded/updated with businessId from @CurrentUser (updateMany {id,businessId})

summary: setMenuTranslations has JwtAuthGuard only (no RolesGuard/@Roles): cashiers/kitchen staff can edit catalog data.

status_note: @Roles(OWNER, MANAGER); controller JwtAuthGuard removed (global)

summary: setMenuTranslations: Prisma CRUD in controller.
fix: Move to products service.
status_note: moved to SelfOrderSessionService

summary: findUnique + update per item in a loop; DTO items array has no @ArrayMaxSize.

summary: MenuTranslationDto.translations is only @IsObject (nested name/description unvalidated, unbounded keys); MenuTranslationBatchDto.items lacks @IsArray/@ArrayMaxSize.

status_note: MenuTranslationBatchDto: IsArray/ArrayMinSize/ArrayMaxSize(100); translations validated by custom IsTranslationMap (locales id/en, name<=255, description<=2000, no extra keys)

summary: Translations are stored by rewriting product.description as a JSON blob; POS/online store/receipts and this module's lang='id' path (lines 118, 415 only parse when language!=='id') then show raw JSON as the description.

summary: Public PUT /sessions/:code/extend lets anyone holding the code extend the session indefinitely, including expired/submitted ones.
fix: Restrict to staff or cap total lifetime; only allow on active sessions.
status_note: extend only for active, non-expired sessions; total lifetime capped at createdAt+6h; throttled

summary: extendSession body `{minutes?}` inline; negative or huge values accepted (scheduler.extendSession adds unchecked).
fix: DTO with @IsInt @Min(1) @Max(60).

summary: initiateQrisPayment body inline `{amount}`; only runtime >0 check, type not enforced.
fix: DTO with @IsNumber @Min(1).
status_note: SelfOrderQrisPaymentDto; endpoint returns 501 NOT_CONFIGURED

summary: @Cron expireSessions/cleanupExpiredSessions (line 40) run on every replica without a distributed lock.

summary: PrismaService is re-provided in SelfOrderModule providers, creating a second PrismaClient instance/connection pool instead of using the global one.

summary: createStore @Body inline type: storeName/slug unvalidated (slug format, length, reserved words); duplicate slug surfaces as Prisma P2002 500.

summary: POST /online-store/stores has no RolesGuard: any employee (cashier/kitchen) can create public storefronts for the business.

status_note: @Roles(OWNER, MANAGER) on POST/GET stores

summary: Public GET /online-store/s/:slug returns the full OnlineStore row (themeSettings incl. inventoryMap/catalogEntries, paymentMethods) and full Product rows (costPrice, sku, barcode, trackStock, businessId, variants with cost) via findActiveProductsByBusinessId.

summary: findActiveProductsByBusinessId (public storefront) loads every active product with variants+category, no take/pagination.
fix: Paginate / cap.
status_note: Repo public product list uses PRODUCT_PUBLIC_SELECT + take cap; storefront endpoints capped at 500

summary: findStoreOrders loads all store orders with items for a store without pagination (GET s/:slug/orders).

status_note: GET s/:slug/orders paginated via PaginationQueryDto (service); repo list capped

summary: getStoreOrders @Query('status') unvalidated string cast to enum; invalid value causes a Prisma 500.

summary: GET s/:slug/orders (customer names, phones, emails, addresses) has no RolesGuard; any employee role can read online-customer PII.

status_note: @Roles(OWNER, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, CASHIER) on store orders list

summary: Public POST s/:slug/orders body is an inline type: no validation of customer fields, items array size, productId format, shippingCost type.

status_note: s/:slug/orders uses validated StorefrontOrderDto (nested, @IsInt @Min(1) @Max, @ArrayMaxSize, phone/email)

summary: shippingCost is taken from the public client body (`dto.shippingCost || 0`) and added to grandTotal; a negative value reduces the order total, any value is accepted.

status_note: Client shippingCost no longer accepted (forbidNonWhitelisted); shipping computed server-side from store settings

summary: reserveInventory's boolean result is ignored: when the atomic reservation fails (insufficient stock / race after the per-item checkStock at 156), the store order is still created without reserving stock -> oversell.
fix: Throw 409 when reserveInventory returns false; do reservation and order creation in one $transaction.
status_note: Reservation replaced by conditional decrement inside the order transaction; count 0 -> 409

summary: Inventory is decremented (reserve) before the store order is created in a separate call; if createStoreOrder fails (e.g. orderNumber unique collision) stock is lost and never released.
fix: Single $transaction for stock decrement + order create.
status_note: Stock decrement + order create in one $transaction

summary: orderNumber = 'SO-'+Date.now().base36 (StoreOrder.orderNumber is globally @unique): concurrent public orders in the same ms collide -> 500 after stock was reserved; same 'SO-' prefix as self-order session codes.
fix: Per-store sequence or crypto-random suffix; retry on conflict.
status_note: Order number via DocumentNumberService (WEB-YYYYMMDD-NNNN) inside the transaction

summary: checkStock (a DB query) awaited per item inside the loop, then reserveInventory re-queries each item.
fix: Single findMany for all stock levels; rely on the transactional reservation.
status_note: Per-item checkStock loop removed; single conditional decrement per merged line in tx

summary: Public order endpoints (POST s/:slug/orders and s/:slug/checkout) decrement real stock and push KDS orders without payment, captcha or @Throttle; also store.isActive is not checked here (inactive stores still accept orders).
fix: Add @Throttle, require isActive, reserve stock only with expiry until payment.
status_note: @Throttle on public routes (checkout 10/min), isActive checked on every public route; stock deducted only atomically

summary: Controller uses PrismaService directly (outlet/product lookups at 122,129 and storeOrder at 307) and contains the whole pricing/stock workflow of createStoreOrder.
fix: Move into OnlineStoreService/use case.
status_note: PrismaService removed from controller; logic moved to OnlineStoreService

summary: Two public checkout implementations: POST s/:slug/orders (controller: client outletId, client shipping, reserves stock, no KDS order) and POST s/:slug/checkout (service: first outlet, shipping 0, direct decrement, creates KDS order). Behaviour, stock and totals diverge.
fix: Keep one checkout path in the service.
status_note: Both s/:slug/orders and s/:slug/checkout call OnlineStoreService.createStorefrontOrder

summary: updateOrderStatus @Body `{status: string}` inline type (manually whitelisted only).

status_note: UpdateStoreOrderStatusDto @IsEnum

summary: Store order status can jump arbitrarily (delivered->pending, cancelled->shipped); cancelling never releases reserved/decremented stock (releaseInventory is never called).

status_note: STORE_ORDER_TRANSITIONS state machine with conditional updateMany; cancel releases stock and cancels kitchen order in same tx

summary: PUT orders/:id/status and PUT orders/:id/fulfill (line 299) have no RolesGuard.

status_note: @Roles on PUT orders/:id/status and fulfill

summary: POST catalog/sync (price overrides) has no RolesGuard; any role can change online prices/catalog selection.

summary: syncCatalogSelective reads storeId from @Query without validation (undefined -> findUnique error 500).

status_note: CatalogSyncQueryDto @IsUUID storeId (kept as query for contract stability)

summary: POST stores/:id/sync-inventory passes storeId and outletId to syncService.syncInventory with no ownership check: any user can read stock of any outlet and overwrite themeSettings of any tenant's store.
fix: Verify store.businessId and outlet.businessId === user.businessId; add @CurrentUser and RolesGuard.
status_note: sync-inventory: @Roles, TenantAccessService.assertOutlet, store scoped by businessId

summary: Public GET stock-check exposes stock availability of any productId/outletId across tenants (no store/slug context); quantity query not validated/converted.

status_note: Stock check moved to public s/:slug/stock-check, scoped to store business/fulfilment outlet, validated query DTO

summary: calculateShipping (public POST shipping/calculate) returns hard-coded fake courier quotes (JNE/SiCepat/GoSend/GrabExpress constants) from a string-equality 'zone' guess, presented as real rates.
fix: Integrate a courier rate API (RajaOngkir/Biteship) or label clearly as estimate per store config.
status_note: Fake courier quotes removed; POST shipping/calculate returns 501 {success:false, reason:NOT_CONFIGURED}

summary: fulfillOrder has no RolesGuard (see 199).

status_note: @Roles on fulfill

summary: fulfillOrder reads status then updates by id without a conditional where; concurrent fulfils both succeed; unpaid (paymentStatus pending) orders can be shipped.

status_note: fulfillOrder scoped by businessId, conditional updateMany (confirmed/processing only); unpaid COD allowed only after merchant confirm (no payment integration exists)

summary: Selective catalog sync stores catalogEntries/onlinePrice overrides into themeSettings JSON, but nothing reads them: storefront and checkout use all active products at basePrice, so price overrides and product selection silently have no effect.

summary: updateStoreSettings @Body typed as interface StoreSettingsInput: ValidationPipe skips it; negative fees/minOrder, non-numeric strings, arbitrary operatingHours strings are stored.

status_note: StoreSettingsDto (@Min(0) @Max, @IsBoolean, HH:mm @Matches, shippingMode @IsIn)

summary: updateStoreSettings never persists shippingMode or flatRateAmount (declared in StoreSettingsInput), so flat_rate/free modes read by calculateShipping/getDeliveryZones can never be enabled; minOrderAmount/isDeliveryEnabled/operating hours are stored but never enforced at checkout.

summary: Public POST stores/:storeId/shipping/calculate @Body inline type; destination undefined crashes estimateDistance (500).

summary: estimateDistance derives 'distance' from a string hash of the destination (1-30 km) and prices delivery from it; customers are quoted arbitrary shipping fees in production (only a log warning).

summary: Storefront checkout hard-codes shippingCost = 0, ignoring store shipping settings/quotes; every delivery order is free shipping.

status_note: Checkout computes shipping from settings (flat/free/threshold/pickup)

summary: Public POST s/:slug/checkout body typed as interface StorefrontOrderInput (not validated). quantity can be negative/fractional: negative quantity passes the stock check (totalStock < negative is false), yields a negative subtotal and INCREMENTS stock via decrement of a negative number.

status_note: Class DTO validation + service-level quantity guard; tests

summary: Stock is checked from a pre-read snapshot and later decremented with a plain updateMany (line 895) outside any transaction/lock; concurrent checkouts oversell and drive stock negative.

summary: Stock availability sums quantity across ALL outlets, but the deduction is applied only to the first active outlet (findFirst without orderBy, line 849, nondeterministic) -> passes check yet drives that outlet negative; KDS order goes to an arbitrary outlet.

status_note: Single deterministic fulfilment outlet (settings.fulfillmentOutletId or oldest active); availability and deduction on that outlet only

summary: Store order creation, stock decrements, kitchen order and kitchen items are separate writes without $transaction; partial failure leaves inconsistent stock/orders.

status_note: Stock + order (nested items) in one $transaction; kitchen order created in its own tx on confirm

summary: stockLevel.updateMany per item and orderItem.create per item (line 919) in loops.

summary: Store orderNumber 'SO-'+timestamp+4 Math.random chars and kitchen orderNumber 'ORD-'+Date.now().base36 (line 907) are not sequential and can collide.

summary: Order subtotal/grandTotal computed with JS number floats from Number(Decimal) (also controller line 167 and analytics line 171).

status_note: Decimal money helpers (money/multiplyMoney/sumMoney), numbers only at the response boundary

summary: getStoreAnalytics loads every store order with items into memory to compute totals; revenue includes cancelled orders.

summary: 'last 7 days' computed from server clock/UTC, not Asia/Jakarta day boundaries.

summary: Public getStorefrontData loads all active products + stock levels, no pagination; inStock sums stock across all outlets.
