status_note: Storefront list capped (500) and stock computed for fulfilment outlet

summary: getStoreInventory: for variants takes the first stock row (any outlet) while product-level sums all outlets; numbers are inconsistent across outlets.

status_note: Inventory computed consistently for fulfilment outlet

summary: OnlineStoreSyncService.syncCatalog, checkStockBulk (317), releaseInventory (403) and calculateShippingWithRates (491) are never called; syncCatalog duplicates OnlineStoreService.syncCatalog.

summary: syncCatalog/syncCatalogSelective (214)/syncInventory (276) catch all errors and return {failed:1, errors:[message]} with HTTP 200 (leaking raw DB error messages).

summary: reserveInventory catches every error (including DB failures) and returns false; the only caller ignores the boolean.

status_note: reserveInventory removed; conditional decrement throws ConflictException

summary: checkStockBulk issues one findFirst per item.

status_note: checkStockBulk removed (dead)

summary: PrismaService re-provided in OnlineStoreModule, creating an extra PrismaClient/connection pool.
fix: Remove from providers; use global DB module.
status_note: PrismaService removed from module providers

summary: GET /kds/overdue does not call verifyOutletAccess: KdsService.getOverdueOrders queries orders by the caller-supplied outletId only, so any user can read another tenant's active orders (items, table ids); when outletId is omitted Prisma drops the filter and returns active orders of ALL tenants.

summary: bump @Body inline type `{orderItemId, station}` not validated; station is accepted but never used by BumpOrderUseCase.

summary: GET /kds/orders query params (status, station, priority) are unvalidated strings; status=completed (advertised in @ApiQuery) is not an OrderItemStatus value and causes a Prisma 500.

summary: markItemPreparing @Body `{station}` inline type: arbitrary station string written to the item.

summary: recallItem @Body `{reason?}` inline type, unbounded.

summary: updateTimerSettings @Body typed as Partial<CookingTimerSettings> interface: not validated, negative/zero/string minutes or extra keys are persisted into business.settings.

summary: Performance report default start-of-day uses server-local Date(y,m,d) instead of Asia/Jakarta/outlet tz.

summary: Controller injects PrismaService for ownership checks (verifyOutletAccess, verifyOrderItemAccess, notifyOrderReady at 243).

summary: KdsController has no RolesGuard for bump/recall/notify endpoints; any role (e.g. inventory staff) can manipulate kitchen state.

summary: Bump sets item 'ready' without checking item/order status: cancelled items/orders can be bumped and a cancelled/completed order is set back to 'ready'. Completion check treats cancelled items as not done, so an order with any cancelled item never becomes ready.

summary: Interactive transaction at default READ COMMITTED: two concurrent bumps of the last two items each see the other as not ready, so neither sets the order to ready.

summary: markItemPreparing updates by id without status check: ready/served/cancelled items can be moved back to preparing; order status is not moved to 'preparing'.

summary: Fallback template interpolates context.title/body into HTML without escaping.

summary: SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASS default to '' silently when SMTP_HOST is set.
fix: Validate all SMTP settings together.

summary: WHATSAPP_API_URL/TOKEN default to Fonnte URL and '' silently; axios call has no timeout.

summary: MockNotificationService is never provided/injected.

summary: InventoryController injects PrismaService and implements barcode lookup, variant CRUD, category CRUD, XLSX import loop and cost-history queries directly in the controller (L92-155, 242-331, 336-395, 450-477, 649).

summary: listProducts returns all products (productRepo.findByBusinessId / outletProductService.getProductsForOutlet) with no take/pagination.

summary: Barcode/SKU lookup (no @Roles) returns full product row incl. costPrice and variant costPrice to cashiers.
fix: Select only POS-needed fields.

summary: GET products/:id (no @Roles) returns costPrice for product and variants to all roles.
fix: Omit cost fields for non-inventory roles.

summary: updateProduct uses @Body() dto: Partial<CreateProductDto>; generic type erases to Object so ValidationPipe skips all validation (negative/strings basePrice, arbitrary costPrice accepted).

summary: updateProduct silently ignores categoryId, sku, trackStock and variants from the body, so these cannot be edited via PUT.
fix: Map all editable fields (with tenant checks for categoryId).
status_note: sku/categoryId(verified)/trackStock/imageUrl null persisted

summary: addVariant/updateVariant SKU uniqueness is check-then-create with no DB unique constraint on (business, sku) -> concurrent requests create duplicate SKUs.
fix: Add a unique index (or advisory lock) and handle P2002.
status_note: variant SKU check under per-business advisory xact lock

summary: addVariant does not set product.hasVariants=true nor create stock_levels rows for outlets, unlike CreateProductUseCase.
fix: Reuse product use case logic; update hasVariants and create stock levels in a transaction.
status_note: addVariant sets hasVariants and creates stock rows for assigned outlets in tx

summary: DELETE variant allows SUPERVISOR while creating/updating variants and deleting products do not; inconsistent role matrix.
fix: Align roles with product mutation endpoints.
status_note: variant delete roles aligned (owner/manager/inventory)

summary: createCategory stores client-supplied parentId without verifying it belongs to caller business (cross-tenant category tree link; children include leaks other tenant category via getCategory).
fix: Verify parentId with findFirst({id,businessId}) before create.
status_note: parentId verified via assertOwned; getCategory children scoped

summary: XLSX preview/import use FileInterceptor without limits/fileFilter: entire upload is buffered in memory before the 10MB check (preview) and importXlsx (L425) has no size check at all; no mimetype check.
fix: FileInterceptor('file',{limits:{fileSize:10MB},fileFilter}) and reject non-xlsx.
status_note: FileInterceptor limits.fileSize 10MB + .xlsx fileFilter on both routes

summary: importXlsx takes @Body('sheetName') and @Body('mappings') as raw strings; JSON.parse result used without shape validation.
fix: Use a DTO with @IsString/@MaxLength and validate parsed mappings array.
status_note: ImportXlsxDto + parsed mappings shape/field whitelist validation

summary: XLSX import creates each product individually outside a transaction and without SKU duplicate check -> partial imports and duplicate SKUs on retry.
fix: Validate all rows first, then create inside $transaction with SKU checks.
status_note: validate all rows then one $transaction with SKU check (advisory lock + batched lookup)

summary: Per-row product.create + assignToAllOutlets (one upsert per outlet) inside loop: rows x outlets queries.
fix: Use createMany and a single outletProduct.createMany.
status_note: createMany products + set-based outlet links

summary: XLSX import basePrice=Number(row.price...) and costPrice=Number(...) are not checked for NaN/negative values.
fix: Validate numeric, >=0 before insert; reject row otherwise.
status_note: strict non-negative numeric parse to Decimal; invalid rows reported

summary: assignProducts uses inline @Body() body: { productIds: string[] } -> ValidationPipe skipped.
fix: Create AssignOutletProductsDto with @IsArray @IsUUID(each) @ArrayMaxSize.
status_note: OutletProductIdsDto (IsUUID each, ArrayMaxSize)

summary: assignProducts passes client productIds to bulkAssign without verifying they belong to caller business; foreign products get linked to own outlet and then returned (with cost) by getProductsForOutlet which has no businessId filter.
fix: Filter productIds with product.findMany({id in, businessId}) before upsert.
status_note: bulkAssign links only products of caller business; test

summary: stock/adjust verifies outlet only; productId/variantId are not verified to belong to the business, and UpdateStockUseCase then rewrites costPrice of that product/variant via moving-average (cross-tenant cost write).
fix: Verify product (and variant.productId) belong to user.businessId before executing.
status_note: UpdateStockUseCase verifies product businessId and variant.productId

summary: GET cost-history/:productId queries costPriceHistory by productId/variantId without any businessId scoping -> any manager can read other tenants' cost history.
fix: Add @BusinessScoped product and filter by product.businessId (and variant.product.businessId).
status_note: cost history requires owned product/variant

summary: variantId query param unvalidated (non-UUID causes Prisma 500).
fix: Use a query DTO with @IsUUID.
status_note: CostHistoryQueryDto @IsUUID

summary: getProductsForOutlet filters only by outletProducts.outletId, no product.businessId filter; combined with unverified bulkAssign it returns other tenants' products.
fix: Add businessId to where clause.
status_note: getProductsForOutlet filters product.businessId

summary: bulkAssign performs one upsert per productId in a loop, not in a transaction.
fix: Use createMany({skipDuplicates}) + updateMany inside $transaction.
status_note: createMany skipDuplicates + updateMany in $transaction

summary: assignToAllOutlets upserts once per outlet in a loop.
fix: Use createMany with skipDuplicates.
status_note: set-based createMany/updateMany

summary: assignProduct() and bulkRemove() (L91) are never called.
fix: Remove or expose.
status_note: assignProduct removed; bulkRemove exposed as DELETE outlets/:outletId/products

summary: CSV/JSON importProducts stores client categoryId without verifying it belongs to the business (cross-tenant category link).
fix: Pre-load business categories and reject unknown ids.
status_note: categoryIds pre-validated against business; test

summary: Per-row try/catch inside interactive $transaction: after the first DB error Postgres aborts the tx, every subsequent row fails with a masked error and the whole import then throws generic "Batch import failed"; raw Prisma messages also leak into errors[].
fix: Validate before tx, do not catch inside tx (or use savepoints); return sanitized errors.
status_note: no catch inside tx; sanitized per-row validation errors

summary: SKU duplicate check via findFirst inside tx is not a lock and there is no unique constraint on (businessId, sku) -> concurrent imports/creates duplicate SKUs.
fix: Add @@unique([businessId, sku]) and catch P2002.
status_note: DB unique (businessId, sku) exists + advisory lock + batched check

summary: Import runs findFirst+create per row inside a long-held transaction.
fix: Batch SKU lookup with findMany(in) and createMany.
status_note: batched category + SKU lookup, createMany

summary: CSV/JSON imported products are not assigned to any outlet (XLSX import and createProduct auto-assign), so non-owner users never see them.
fix: Call outlet assignment for imported products.
status_note: imported products assigned to all active outlets

summary: Import parses prices with parseFloat/Number (L166-167, L188-189) into JS floats.
fix: Parse to Prisma.Decimal / integer rupiah.
status_note: strict parse; stored via money() Decimal

summary: escapeCsvField does not neutralize values starting with = + - @ so exported product CSV allows spreadsheet formula injection from product names/descriptions.
fix: Prefix such values with a single quote.
status_note: csvCell neutralises = + - @ and quotes; test

summary: Auto transfer number = count(businessId)+1 plus 3-char Math.random suffix; transferNumber is globally @unique so collisions across tenants/concurrency are possible.
fix: Use per-tenant sequence table or @@unique([businessId, transferNumber]) with DB sequence.
status_note: auto transfer number via DocumentNumberService 'TRF' inside tx; low-stock filtered in SQL

summary: Bulk price/cost update computes new prices with JS floats and Math.round to integer (destroys fractional cost prices).
fix: Use Prisma.Decimal arithmetic with explicit rounding rule.
status_note: price math in SQL NUMERIC; price rounds to rupiah, cost keeps 2dp

summary: Bulk price update reads products outside the transaction then writes inside -> lost updates vs concurrent edits.
fix: Read inside tx or use SQL UPDATE ... SET price = price * x.
status_note: single set-based UPDATE (no read-then-write)

summary: Bulk price update issues one product.update per product in a loop.
fix: Use a single SQL UPDATE with expression.
status_note: one UPDATE statement

summary: Bulk CATEGORY action sets client categoryId without verifying the category belongs to the business.
fix: Verify categoryId with findFirst({id,businessId}).
status_note: bulk category verified via assertOwned; test

summary: Hard delete checks transaction history then deletes in separate statements outside a transaction.
fix: Wrap check+delete in $transaction or rely on FK restrict.
status_note: history check + delete in one $transaction

summary: Product export loads every product of the business in one findMany.
fix: Stream/paginate for large catalogs.
status_note: export capped at 10000 rows

summary: GET suppliers/:id/purchase-history and :id/payment-status are defined both here and in SuppliersController (L278/L283). InventoryModule is registered before SuppliersModule, so these handlers win and SuppliersService.getPurchaseHistory/getPaymentStatus are unreachable.
fix: Keep one implementation and delete the other.
status_note: Duplicate routes removed (supplier-analytics.controller deleted); single implementation in SuppliersController/Service

summary: SupplierAnalyticsController injects PrismaService and computes analytics in the controller.
fix: Move into SuppliersService.
status_note: Controller deleted; logic in SuppliersService

summary: Purchase history query filters POs by supplierId only (not outlet.businessId); because createPO does not verify supplierId, other tenants' POs against this supplier are returned.
fix: Add outlet: { businessId } to where.
status_note: Purchase history filtered by outlet.businessId

summary: getDateRange computes day boundaries with server-local setHours instead of Asia/Jakarta/outlet tz.
fix: Use a tz-aware helper.
status_note: Date range via business-time getDateRange

summary: Payment status treats every received PO as paid and every other as debt; overdueOrdersCount hardcoded 0 and overdueOrders [] (L197, L202) - fabricated finance figures.
fix: Model supplier payments or label as estimate; compute overdue.
status_note: Honest PO receipt summary, paymentTracking NOT_AVAILABLE, no fake overdue/due dates (aliases kept, handoff to web)

summary: Totals/averages computed with Decimal.toNumber() float sums (L84, L171).
fix: Aggregate with Decimal or SQL SUM.
status_note: Totals via groupBy _sum + Decimal

summary: Payment status loads all POs of supplier without limit.
fix: Aggregate in SQL.
status_note: Payment status aggregated with groupBy; open list capped 100

summary: SuppliersController injects PrismaService and builds PO (number, totals, items) in the controller (L205-223).
fix: Move PO creation into a use case.
status_note: PO creation moved to SuppliersService.createPurchaseOrder; no Prisma in controller

summary: GET /suppliers returns all suppliers without pagination.
fix: Paginate.
status_note: GET /suppliers take/skip (default/max 100)

summary: create supplier uses inline @Body() type -> no validation (email/phone/name length).
fix: CreateSupplierDto class.
status_note: CreateSupplierDto

summary: update supplier takes @Body() Record<string, unknown> and repo.update passes it straight into prisma.supplier.update (SR L39-43): mass assignment of any column incl. businessId (move supplier into another tenant) and id.
fix: UpdateSupplierDto with whitelisted fields; never pass raw body to Prisma.
status_note: UpdateSupplierDto whitelisted; businessId never settable

summary: createPO uses inline @Body() type: no validation of items array, quantityOrdered/unitCost (negative/NaN), ids.
fix: CreatePurchaseOrderDto with ValidateNested, @Min(0), @IsUUID.
status_note: CreatePurchaseOrderDto with ValidateNested, IsUUID, IsPositive qty, Min(0) cost, ArrayMaxSize

summary: createPO does not verify supplierId nor items productId/variantId/ingredientId belong to the business; on receive, ReceivePurchaseOrderUseCase writes stock and moving-average costPrice into those (possibly foreign) products/variants.
fix: Verify all referenced ids with businessId-scoped queries before create.

summary: PO number = PO-Date.now().toString(36); poNumber is globally @unique -> concurrent/cross-tenant collisions (P2002 500).

summary: PO totalAmount and item subtotal computed as JS float quantity*unitCost.
fix: Use Decimal multiplication.

status_note: Actor from JWT; approvedBy/rejectedBy removed from DTOs (handoff to web)

summary: listPOs status query param unvalidated (invalid enum -> Prisma 500).
fix: Query DTO with @IsEnum.
status_note: PurchaseOrderListQueryDto status @IsEnum

summary: findPurchaseOrdersByOutlet returns all POs of outlet; business path is capped at 100 with no page param exposed (silently truncated).

status_note: page/limit exposed on both paths

summary: SupplierAnalyticsQueryDto requires a businessId query param that is never used (client must send arbitrary string).
fix: Remove field.
status_note: Removed unused businessId from SupplierAnalyticsQueryDto

summary: AutoReorderDto/ReorderSuggestionsQueryDto outletId are @IsString not @IsUUID; bad ids reach ::uuid raw casts -> 500.
fix: Use @IsUUID.
status_note: outletId @IsUUID in AutoReorderDto/ReorderSuggestionsQueryDto

summary: getSupplierAnalytics loads every supplier with all POs+items in the date range.

summary: getReorderSuggestions calls findPreferredSupplier (one query) per low-stock product.

summary: findPreferredSupplier queries purchaseOrderItem by productId across all tenants (no outlet.businessId filter); with cross-tenant PO items it can return another tenant's supplierId, used by autoReorder to create POs.

summary: autoReorder fetches supplier per group and creates POs one by one.

summary: autoReorder creates multiple POs outside a transaction and is not idempotent (repeated calls create duplicate draft POs).

summary: Auto-reorder POs are created with placeholder unitCost 0 / totalAmount 0; receiving them skips cost calculation.

summary: Auto PO numbers use Date.now base36 (+supplierId prefix / -DFLT at L353) - collisions within same ms/loop and global unique poNumber.

summary: approvePurchaseOrder/rejectPurchaseOrder (L459) check status then update separately -> double approve/reject races.

summary: approve/reject overwrite PO notes and approvedBy is never persisted (only echoed back).

summary: getPendingPurchaseOrders returns all draft POs with items/employee/outlet includes.

summary: Lead-time trend month key uses server-local getFullYear/getMonth.

summary: getSupplierComparison loads every received PO item of the business with includes, unbounded.

summary: mostExpensiveSupplier is set to mostExpensive.avgPrice (a number) instead of supplier name.
fix: Use supplierName.

summary: getReorderAlerts takes 500 stock levels before filtering low-stock, so alerts beyond first 500 rows are silently missed.
fix: Filter quantity<=low_stock_alert in SQL, then limit.
status_note: Low-stock filter in SQL before LIMIT

summary: Purchase totals/averages/debt computed with Number() float sums (L80, L579, L630-636).
fix: Use Decimal/SQL SUM.
status_note: sumMoney/Decimal and SQL aggregates

summary: receivePurchaseOrder repository method is never called (ReceivePurchaseOrderUseCase used instead).
fix: Remove.
status_note: Dead repo receivePurchaseOrder deleted with repository

summary: findById/update/deactivate/findPurchaseOrderById operate by id only; tenant safety relies entirely on controller guards.
fix: Add businessId parameter to repository methods.
status_note: Repository deleted; SuppliersService scopes every query by businessId

summary: Status check (ordered) happens before and outside the transaction; two concurrent receive calls both pass and stock + moving-average cost are applied twice.
fix: Inside tx: updateMany({where:{id,status:'ordered'}}) and abort if count=0.
status_note: Conditional updateMany status in (ordered,partial) inside tx; count 0 -> 409

summary: Inside $transaction, stock level is read and written via inventoryRepo (non-tx Prisma client) with absolute newQty=prevQty+received (L127): not rolled back on failure and loses concurrent sales/adjustments.
fix: Use tx client and quantity: { increment }.
status_note: All writes on tx client; stock via increment with explicit variantId null; base row created if missing

summary: calculateMovingAvgCost uses the global Prisma client, so product costPrice/history are committed even if the PO transaction rolls back.
fix: Pass tx into the cost use case.
status_note: Moving-average use case receives tx

summary: Ingredient-only PO items are skipped (ingredient stock never increases from POs); receivedQty uses quantityReceived||quantityOrdered and only full receiving from status ordered is supported (no partial).
fix: Handle ingredientId items via ingredient stock; support partial receipt.
status_note: Ingredient lines increment ingredient stock + movement + weighted costPerUnit; partial receipt via optional items body (status partial)

summary: Per-item findStockLevel/create/cost/update/movement queries in loop.
fix: Batch lookups.
status_note: Stock levels prefetched in one query; per-line writes are atomic increments

summary: Weighted moving average cost computed with JS floats and Math.round to 4 dp.
fix: Compute with Prisma.Decimal.
status_note: Decimal weightedAverageCost (4dp HALF_UP)

summary: Reads costPrice then writes new costPrice without lock/transaction -> concurrent receipts compute from stale cost.
fix: Run in caller tx with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE.
status_note: execute(input, tx) locks product/variant row FOR UPDATE before reading cost

summary: existingQuantity is the stock of a single outlet while costPrice is product-global, so multi-outlet businesses get wrong weighted averages.
fix: Use total stock across outlets (or per-outlet cost).
status_note: Existing quantity = sum of stock across all outlets (base row: variantId null)

summary: findFirst then absolute update quantity=newQuantity inside default READ COMMITTED tx without row lock -> concurrent adjustments/sales are lost; create path races on NULL variantId (unique allows duplicate NULLs).
fix: Use increment/decrement or SELECT FOR UPDATE; handle NULL-variant uniqueness.
status_note: row ensured via createMany skipDuplicates (covers NULL-variant partial unique), locked FOR UPDATE, increment / conditional decrement; tests

summary: Moving-average cost update runs through the global Prisma client inside the tx callback, not rolled back if stock update fails.
fix: Pass tx.
status_note: moving-average cost called with tx before increment

summary: variantId is never checked to belong to productId (nor either to the business) before creating stock level and updating variant cost.
fix: Validate variant.productId === productId and product.businessId.
status_note: product scoped by businessId, variant must belong to product; tests

summary: quantity must be > 0 so adjustmentType set cannot set stock to 0.
fix: Allow quantity 0 for set.
status_note: 'set' accepts 0; increment/decrement require >0

summary: categoryId from client stored without verifying it belongs to business.
fix: Verify category.businessId.
status_note: categoryId verified via TenantAccessService.assertOwned

summary: modifierGroupIds from client linked without verifying ownership -> product shows/charges another tenant's modifier groups.
fix: Verify modifierGroup.businessId for all ids.
status_note: modifierGroupIds verified via assertOwned('modifierGroup') before tx; test

summary: Product, variants, modifier links, outlet assignments and stock levels created in separate statements without $transaction -> partial products on failure.
fix: Wrap in $transaction.
status_note: product/variants/modifiers/outlets/stock rows in one $transaction

summary: Nested loops create variants, modifier links, outlet upserts and stock levels one query at a time (outlets x variants).
fix: Use createMany.
status_note: createMany for variants, modifier links, outlet links, stock levels

summary: SKU uniqueness check-then-create race; also throws ErrorCode.PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND for a duplicate.
fix: Unique index + DUPLICATE_RESOURCE code.
status_note: advisory SKU lock in tx + P2002 -> 409 Conflict (no PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND code)

summary: CheckLowStockUseCase is not registered in any module (also N+1 per record at L41).
fix: Remove or wire up with batched query.
status_note: dead CheckLowStockUseCase + spec deleted

summary: findByCategoryId is never used.
fix: Remove.
status_note: findByCategoryId still declared by B6 interface; removal handed off | resolved via handoff

summary: findById/update/delete are id-only; tenant safety depends on @BusinessScoped at each caller.
fix: Add businessId to where.
status_note: impl findById/update/delete accept businessId and scope; interface (B6) + B2 callers handed off | resolved via handoff

summary: findStockLevelsByOutlet returns all stock rows of outlet without pagination.
fix: Paginate.
status_note: stock list capped (5000) / optional pagination in InventoryService.listStockLevels; repo take cap

summary: findLowStockItems raw query returns no product info, so GET stock/:outletId/low returns rows without product names.
fix: Join products and map.
status_note: low-stock query joins products/variants and returns names/sku

summary: Controller injects PrismaService and contains approve/ship/receive/direct transfer business logic and stock mutation (L88-438).
fix: Move to use cases.
status_note: approve/ship/receive/direct logic moved to StockTransfersService; controller no longer injects PrismaService

summary: GET /stock-transfers returns all transfers with items and full outlet rows, no pagination.
fix: Paginate and select fields.
status_note: list paginated via take/skip (default/max 100, array kept); outlets/employees select {id,name}

summary: status query unvalidated (invalid enum -> 500).
fix: Query DTO with @IsEnum.
status_note: ListStockTransfersQueryDto with @IsEnum(StockTransferStatus)

summary: POST /stock-transfers uses inline @Body() type: items/quantity/ids unvalidated (negative quantity, non-UUID).
fix: CreateTransferDto with nested validation.
status_note: CreateStockTransferDto with nested TransferItemDto (@IsUUID, @IsPositive, ArrayMin/MaxSize)

summary: execute({businessId: user.businessId, ...dto}) lets a body businessId override the caller's; sourceOutletId/destinationOutletId/product ids are never verified (RequestTransferUseCase does not check) -> transfers touching other tenants' outlets whose receive moves their stock.
fix: Spread dto first then set businessId; verify both outlets and all item ids belong to user.businessId.
status_note: businessId/requestedBy set from JWT after explicit field mapping; use case asserts both outlets and product/variant/ingredient ownership

summary: approve (and ship L138) read status then update in a separate statement -> double transitions under concurrency.
fix: updateMany with status in where and check count.
status_note: approve/ship use conditional updateMany (status in where) in $transaction; 404 vs 409 distinguished

summary: receive checks status in_transit outside the transaction; two concurrent receives both move stock.
fix: Conditional updateMany inside tx as first statement.
status_note: receive: conditional status flip is first statement inside $transaction; second receive -> 409

summary: receive: when item.variantId is null the where omits variantId, so updateMany decrements every variant row of the product (and findFirst picks an arbitrary one for increment); ingredient items (productId null) match all product-less rows; source stock can go negative.
fix: Always filter variantId: item.variantId ?? null, handle ingredientId separately, check availability.
status_note: variantId: item.variantId ?? null always in where; ingredients via ingredientStockLevel; conditional decrement (quantity >= n) -> 409

summary: receive creates no stock_movement rows (no audit trail) and never sets quantityReceived, so StockTransfersService.getDiscrepancies reports every received transfer as 100% discrepant.
fix: Record transfer_out/in movements and set quantityReceived (accept per-item received qty).
status_note: receive writes transfer_out/transfer_in StockMovement (IngredientStockMovement for ingredients) and sets quantityReceived from ReceiveTransferDto (default quantitySent)

summary: Per-item updateMany/findFirst/update in receive loop.
fix: Batch.
status_note: movements batched with createMany; per-item stock updates remain (distinct rows)

summary: POST direct uses inline @Body() type; negative quantity passes the availability check (available < -n is false) and reverses stock (increments source, decrements destination).
fix: DTO with @IsPositive quantity and @IsUUID ids.
status_note: DirectStockTransferDto with @IsPositive quantity and @IsUUID ids

summary: Direct transfer never verifies sourceOutletId/destinationOutletId/productId belong to caller business -> can pull stock out of another tenant's outlet into own outlet.
fix: Verify both outlets and products with businessId before tx.
status_note: direct transfer asserts both outlets and all item ids belong to caller business before tx

summary: Availability checked via findFirst then decremented later without row lock -> concurrent sales/transfers drive stock negative.
fix: Use conditional updateMany where quantity >= qty and check count.
status_note: availability enforced by conditional updateMany decrement with count check

summary: Transfer number TRF-D-Date.now base36, globally unique -> collisions.
fix: Per-tenant sequence.
status_note: DocumentNumberService.next(tx, businessId, 'TRF')

summary: StockTransferStatusChangedEvent is published inside the transaction callback before commit (emitted even if commit fails).
fix: Publish after $transaction resolves.
status_note: events published after $transaction resolves

summary: auto-request passes client destinationOutletId/sourceOutletId without verifying ownership; service raw query reads other tenant's low-stock products and creates a transfer from their outlet.
fix: verifyOutletAccess for both outlets.
status_note: auto-request asserts both outlets (TenantAccessService), source != destination, low-stock query also filters p.business_id

summary: findUnique(...).catch(() => null) hides DB errors as 404.
fix: Validate id format with ParseUUIDPipe, let other errors surface.
status_note: ParseUUIDPipe + findFirst({id,businessId}); no .catch(()=>null)

status_note: Partial unique index uq_stock_outlet_product_no_variant ON stock_levels(outlet_id, product_id) WHERE variant_id IS NULL (duplicate pre-check), documented in schema comment.

summary: StockOpname.opnameNumber is a GLOBAL @unique; generated codes of one tenant collide with (and can be blocked by) another tenant; number generators using per-tenant count+1 will hit P2002 across tenants.
fix: Replace with @@unique([outletId, opnameNumber]) and a distinct prefix from self-order 'SO-'; generate numbers per tenant with a sequence/counter row.
status_note: StockOpname.opnameNumber global unique replaced by @@unique([outletId, opnameNumber]) uq_opname_outlet_number. Distinct prefix is a code change (generator owners).

summary: StockOpname: FK column(s) without index: createdBy, approvedBy. Postgres does not auto-index FKs; joins/filters and ON DELETE checks scan the child table.
fix: Add @@index for createdBy, approvedBy.
status_note: idx_opname_created_by, idx_opname_approved_by.

summary: StockOpnameItem: FK column(s) without index: productId, variantId. Postgres does not auto-index FKs; joins/filters and ON DELETE checks scan the child table.
fix: Add @@index for productId, variantId.
status_note: idx_opname_items_product, idx_opname_items_variant.

summary: CostPriceHistory has no updatedAt; acceptable only if the table is append-only - nothing enforces immutability.
fix: Keep append-only (no update paths) or add updatedAt.
status_note: Append-only ledger by design (no update paths); documented with a schema comment instead of adding updatedAt.

summary: DB_USER defaults to 'postgres' and DB_HOST to localhost (compose uses 'tilopos'); no PGPASSWORD handling, no restore script, not scheduled anywhere; S3 upload optional and goes to same bucket family as uploads; backups unencrypted.
fix: Use DATABASE_URL, require credentials, add restore + scheduled CronJob, encrypt and ship to a separate bucket.
status_note: backup-db.sh requires DATABASE_URL, custom-format dump, optional gpg, dedicated BACKUP_S3_BUCKET; added restore-db.sh; k8s CronJob (INFRA) schedules

summary: pg_dump | gzip pipeline: with set -o pipefail it fails correctly, but a failed run leaves a truncated .sql.gz file in the backup dir that retention later treats as a valid backup.
fix: Write to temp file and mv on success; verify with gunzip -t.
status_note: dump to temp file, verify with pg_restore --list, mv on success; retention only after success

summary: Engine computes discount from caller-supplied items[].price and total (ApplyPromotionUseCase passes client body through) without loading server prices, so discount previews/amounts can be inflated.
fix: Load product/variant prices from DB by productId (scoped to businessId) and compute total server-side.
status_note: ApplyPromotionUseCase loads product/variant prices from DB

summary: Percentage (and fixed) discount is computed on context.total (whole cart) even when promotion is restricted to productIds; a 50% promo on one product discounts the whole cart.
fix: Compute discount base as the sum of matching items only.
status_note: discount base = matching lines

summary: Discounts computed with JS floats from Decimal.toNumber() then Math.floor.
fix: Use Prisma.Decimal / integer rupiah.
status_note: Decimal

summary: Outlet filter is skipped entirely when context.outletId is not provided, so outlet-restricted promotions apply to any outlet.
fix: Treat missing outletId as not matching when outlets filter is set.
status_note: missing outlet never matches

summary: Promotions with applicableTo.customerSegments are applied to ALL customers (segment check not implemented, only a warn log), so segment-restricted promos (e.g. VIP-only) are given to everyone.
fix: Load customer segment/tier and reject when not matching; fail closed if customerId missing.
status_note: segment check fails closed

summary: categoryIds filter is never evaluated: category-only promotions never match any cart (logs warning per item).
fix: Load product->category map for context.items and match categoryIds.
status_note: category matching via product categories

summary: incrementUsageCount updates promotion by id only (no businessId) and without checking usageLimit atomically (unused today, but exported API).
fix: Use updateMany where {id, businessId, OR usageLimit null / usedCount < usageLimit} and check count; or delete if unused.
status_note: businessId + atomic usage limit

summary: MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY defaults to '' (rejects webhooks when empty; fail-closed) but boot only warns.
fix: Validate at boot when PAYMENT_GATEWAY=midtrans.
status_note: Midtrans use-case fails closed without key; boot validation requires it when PAYMENT_GATEWAY=midtrans in prod

summary: XENDIT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN defaults to '' (verification methods return false/throw when empty, so fail-closed, but main.ts only warns).
fix: Make webhook secrets required when the corresponding gateway is enabled in production.
status_note: Xendit webhook use-case no longer reads token (verification solely in WebhookGuard, fail-closed); boot validation requires XENDIT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN in prod

summary: isApplicableAt uses date.getDay() and date.toTimeString() (server TZ) to match applicableDays/timeFrom/timeUntil; in UTC containers a 'happy hour 15:00-17:00' rule fires at 22:00-00:00 WIB.
fix: Convert currentTime to outlet timezone before extracting weekday/HH:MM.
status_note: same as F0308

summary: Time window check does string compare currentTime < timeFrom / > timeUntil, so overnight windows (e.g. 22:00-02:00) never match.
fix: Handle timeFrom > timeUntil as wrap-around.
status_note: overnight windows (from > until) wrap around; test

summary: PricingRule.applyDiscount is never called.
fix: Remove.
status_note: applyDiscount removed (+its tests); calculateDiscount capped at price and uses Decimal money helpers

summary: Barrel omits TransactionVoided/Shift*/PaymentReceived/DeviceSyncStatus events; inconsistent barrel, consumers import files directly.
fix: Export all events or drop the barrel.
status_note: events barrel exports all events

summary: PaymentReceivedEvent is never constructed or listened to.
fix: Remove or emit it from payment flows.
status_note: PaymentReceivedEvent deleted

summary: UnauthorizedActionException is never thrown anywhere.
fix: Remove.
status_note: UnauthorizedActionException deleted

summary: Interface contracts findById/update/delete(id) lack businessId, forcing unscoped implementations (same in product, order, shift, transaction, supplier, promotion, table, device, ingredient, credit-sale, settlement, notification, loyalty, online-store, employee, settings.repository interfaces)
fix: Add businessId to every by-id method signature in domain repository interfaces
status_note: scope added to shift/notification/device/employee/audit/order/table/product/customer/promotion/loyalty/inventory interfaces (required where callers comply, optional otherwise); ISettingsRepository, ICreditSaleRepository, ISupplierRepository removed; online-store unscoped methods removed. transaction/ingredient/settlement untouched (B2/B4 owned impls)

summary: maxApplicationsPerTransaction is compared against the count of different rules applied to a single product in this call, not applications per transaction; the check 'break's the whole loop instead of skipping that rule.
fix: Track applications per rule across the cart and 'continue' instead of break.
status_note: applications tracked per rule across cart; continue instead of break

summary: Money value object stores amount as JS number (add/subtract unrounded), fed from Decimal.toNumber(); float drift possible for non-integer amounts.
fix: Store integer minor units or Prisma.Decimal inside Money.
status_note: Money holds Prisma.Decimal; add/subtract exact, multiply rounds to rupiah; .decimal getter

summary: CacheInterceptor and @InvalidateCache are never used; if applied, key `http:${request.url}` is not scoped by businessId/user so one tenant's GET response would be served to another.
fix: Delete, or include businessId/userId in the key before using.
status_note: CacheInterceptor + InvalidateCache deleted (unused)

summary: Held-bill index list is read-modify-written as a JSON array (get, push, set); two cashiers holding/resuming concurrently lose bill ids from the list (bill becomes invisible).
fix: Use Redis SADD/SREM/SMEMBERS on a set key (or a hash) for atomic membership.
status_note: Redis SET

summary: Held-bill keys are scoped only by outletId + billId; store trusts caller-provided outletId, no businessId in key or ownership check at this layer.
fix: Include businessId in key and verify outlet belongs to caller's business in the use cases.
status_note: keys include businessId; outlet verified in controller

summary: list() issues one Redis GET per held bill id.
fix: Use MGET for all keys.
status_note: MGET

summary: REDIS_HOST/PORT/DB default to localhost:6379/0 and password optional; in k8s a missing env silently points at localhost and cache/held-bills fail at runtime.
fix: Require REDIS_HOST (or REDIS_URL) in production via config schema.
status_note: redisConnectionOptions(): throws without REDIS_HOST in production, numeric validation; used by RedisModule and BullMQ

summary: CDN_URL defaults '' and CDN_PROVIDER 'none' read from process.env directly (bypasses ConfigService).
fix: Read through ConfigService with schema.
status_note: cdn/ deleted (dead); local adapter CDN_URL now via ConfigService

summary: purgeCdnCache is a stub returning success:true ('purge stub') and is never called; getCdnConfig only used by the dead middleware.
fix: Remove or implement provider purge.
status_note: deleted

summary: StaticAssetsMiddleware never applied; would set Access-Control-Allow-Origin '*' when CDN_URL unset.
fix: Remove or register with explicit origin config.
status_note: deleted

summary: Ad-hoc script mutating product images across DB, not referenced, compiled into dist.
fix: Delete or move to scripts/.
status_note: Deleted add-product-images.ts (dead ad-hoc script).

summary: Ad-hoc script operating on business.findFirst() (arbitrary tenant), not referenced by any npm script, compiled into dist.
fix: Delete or move to scripts/ with explicit businessId arg.
status_note: Deleted add-sample-products.ts (dead ad-hoc script).

summary: Ad-hoc debug script with top-level PrismaClient, not referenced anywhere, compiled into dist.
fix: Delete or move to scripts/.
status_note: Deleted check-data.ts (dead ad-hoc script).

summary: All seeded accounts (incl. super_admin superadmin@tilopos.id) share PIN '1234'; printed at index.ts:179-190. If the seed ever runs in prod, a super admin with a trivial PIN exists.
fix: Generate random PINs from env / print once; block seeding super admin in production.
status_note: Demo PIN now SEED_DEFAULT_PIN (default 1234 kept for dev/integration tests, validated); the whole demo seed (incl. super admin) refuses to run in production. Login list printed from one DEMO_LOGINS table matching employees.seeder.ts.

summary: cleanupDatabase() runs deleteMany on business, employee, transaction, payment etc. unconditionally; the script is registered as package.json prisma.seed and db:seed, so `prisma migrate reset`/`db seed` or an accidental run against DATABASE_URL in production wipes all tenant data. No NODE_ENV/confirmation guard.
fix: Refuse to run when NODE_ENV==='production' or DATABASE_URL host is not local unless --force; never wipe in the default seed.
status_note: Destructive seed only runs when NODE_ENV !== production AND ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=true; otherwise aborts with a clear message.

summary: cleanupDatabase omits 27 models (BusinessFeature, OutletFeature, OutletProduct, PriceTier, BatchLot, Appointment, WorkOrder, SerialNumber, PricingRule, CreditSale, CreditPayment, BundlePackage*, Subscription, Invoice, StockOpname*, CostPriceHistory, UnitConversion, EmployeeSchedule/Attendance, SagaState, ReportTemplate, AppVersion, ServiceItem); once any such row exists, business/outlet/product deleteMany fails on FK Restrict and re-seed breaks.
fix: Use TRUNCATE ... CASCADE in dev or `prisma migrate reset`.
status_note: cleanupDatabase now TRUNCATEs every table except _prisma_migrations (RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE), covering all current and future models.

summary: seedPricingRules is exported but never called by index.ts or any script.
fix: Call it from the main seed or delete.
status_note: seedPricingRules is now called from index.ts after products.

summary: Tenant import is dozens of sequential creates without $transaction; the name-exists check means a partial failure leaves a half-imported business that blocks re-runs.
fix: Wrap import in $transaction (or chunked with cleanup on failure).
status_note: seed-udsayan import runs in one $transaction (spreadsheets read beforehand), so a failure leaves nothing behind.

summary: Real-customer import script creates owner udsayan@tilopos.id and one cashier per outlet with PIN '1234', premium plan until 2027-12-31, reads spreadsheets from repo-relative ../UDSAYAN directory (customer PII).
fix: Take PIN from env/prompt, force PIN change on first login, keep customer data out of repo.
status_note: PIN from SEED_INITIAL_PIN or a random 6-digit PIN printed once; data dir configurable via UDSAYAN_DIR (keep PII outside the repo). Forced PIN change on first login needs an auth feature and is not implemented.

summary: Ad-hoc debug script (test-products-api.ts) lives in src, not referenced by any npm script, compiled into dist (tsconfig.build excludes only spec).
fix: Move ad-hoc scripts to packages/backend/scripts or delete; exclude seeders from build.
status_note: Deleted test-products-api.ts (and seed.ts.backup, stale MIGRATION_GUIDE.md).

summary: EventStoreV2 (upcasters, snapshots, migrations) is never used; contains unscoped getEvents/getEventsByType findMany without take and zero-UUID businessId sentinel writes.
fix: Remove, or tenant-scope and paginate before use.
status_note: EventStoreV2 deleted; EventStoreModule left as empty placeholder until AppModule import removed (handoff B1)

summary: EventStore is registered globally but never injected outside infrastructure/events; also its append() uses a read-max-version-then-insert race and a zero-UUID businessId that violates the AuditLog->Business FK.
fix: Delete EventStore/EventStoreModule or fix and actually use it (unique (entityId,version), real businessId).
status_note: EventStore deleted (+test/unit/event-store.spec.ts)

summary: OrderStatusChangedEvent handler errors (audit log, table release) only logged; table can remain 'occupied' forever.
fix: Retry via durable job or surface to monitoring.
status_note: listener side effects retried with backoff (withRetry), final failure logged at error

summary: Count of active orders on table then updateMany to 'available' is check-then-act without lock; an order created between count and update leaves an occupied table marked available.
fix: Do count+update in a single SQL statement (UPDATE ... WHERE NOT EXISTS active orders) or $transaction with row lock.
status_note: table release is a single UPDATE ... WHERE NOT EXISTS active orders

summary: SagaOrchestrator is provided but no code creates sagas; its in-memory sagaLogs array grows unbounded if ever used.
fix: Remove or persist saga logs with retention.
status_note: SagaOrchestrator deleted (+test/unit/saga-orchestrator.spec.ts)

summary: createOrderSagaSteps is never referenced; steps also do unlocked read-modify-write ingredient deductions with clamp to 0 and N+1 queries.
fix: Delete the saga or rewrite with atomic decrements before wiring in.
status_note: create-order saga deleted

summary: Alert fires on every stock change at/below threshold (no dedupe/cooldown), spamming managers and notification_logs on each sale of a low item.
fix: Only alert on crossing the threshold (previousQuantity>threshold>=newQuantity) or add a per-product cooldown key in Redis.
status_note: alert only on threshold crossing; test

summary: notificationService.send awaited per manager in a loop.
fix: Use sendBulk / Promise.allSettled.
status_note: sendBulk instead of per-manager awaits

summary: Low-stock alert sends channel 'push' without metadata.pushToken/businessId, so NotificationDispatcher sends nothing (and PushService is a mock anyway), yet a notificationLog row with status 'sent' is written at line 85 -> UI shows alerts delivered that never were.
fix: Resolve device push tokens / email for managers, record actual delivery result as status, or mark 'pending'/'failed'.
status_note: alerts via email with businessId/notificationType metadata; dispatcher logs real status; fake sent log removed; test

summary: handleTransactionCreated is not idempotent: no check whether ingredients/loyalty were already applied for transactionId; a re-published TransactionCreatedEvent (offline sync retry, bridge re-emit) deducts stock and awards points twice.
fix: Record processed (eventType, transactionId) in a table with unique key or check existing ingredientStockMovement/loyaltyTransaction for referenceId before applying.
status_note: advisory lock + audit-log marker makes effects idempotent

summary: Failures of ingredient deduction, loyalty award and audit log are only logged (TODO DLQ); stock/loyalty permanently drift with no retry or alert. Handler is fire-and-forget via void in subscribe().
fix: Move side effects to a durable BullMQ job (jobId=transactionId) with retries and a DLQ/alert, or execute them inside the originating $transaction.
status_note: BullMQ queue (jobId per tx, 8 attempts, exponential backoff, failed set kept as DLQ); inline fallback if queue unavailable

summary: deductIngredients: recipe.findFirst per transaction item, then ingredientStockLevel.findFirst + update + movement.create per recipe item (nested loop queries).
fix: Batch-load recipes for all productIds and stock levels for all ingredientIds with findMany/in, then createMany movements.
status_note: recipes batch loaded; createMany movements

summary: deductIngredients reads ingredientStockLevel then writes quantity=max(0,old-qty) outside any transaction; concurrent sales lose updates and stock is silently clamped to 0 (movement still records full -qty, so ledger and level diverge).
fix: Use atomic { decrement } inside $transaction (or SELECT ... FOR UPDATE), allow/flag negative stock instead of clamping, write level+movement together.
status_note: atomic decrement in $transaction; negative stock allowed and logged, not clamped

summary: addLoyaltyPoints loads customer by event.customerId only (id comes from client in create-transaction) and credits points/totalSpent to it without verifying customer.businessId equals the transaction outlet's business; cross-tenant loyalty/stat pollution.
fix: Load outlet.businessId for event.outletId and query customer with where {id, businessId}; skip otherwise.
status_note: customer loaded with businessId of the sale outlet

summary: Points use loyaltyProgram.amountPerPoint while create-transaction.use-case.ts:557 computes the returned loyaltyPointsEarned from pointsPerAmount; receipt/response shows different points than actually credited. amountPerPoint=0 gives Infinity.
fix: Compute points in one shared domain function used by both places; guard amountPerPoint<=0.
status_note: shared computeLoyaltyPoints, guards amountPerPoint<=0

summary: Loyalty points and customer.totalSpent increments computed from event.grandTotal as JS number floats (grandTotal typed number, Decimal .toNumber()).
fix: Carry grandTotal as Prisma.Decimal/integer rupiah and compute points with Decimal arithmetic.
status_note: grandTotal read as Decimal from DB

summary: Loyalty award is 3-4 separate writes (customer.update increment, loyaltyTransaction.create, tier update) outside $transaction; partial failure leaves points without ledger row or wrong tier.
fix: Wrap customer increment + loyaltyTransaction.create + tier update in prisma.$transaction.
status_note: customer stats + ledger + tier in the same $transaction

summary: totalSpent/visitCount incremented here for every TransactionCreatedEvent, but create-credit-transaction.use-case.ts:415 already increments totalSpent and visitCount before publishing the same event -> credit sales double-count customer spend and visits.
fix: Increment customer stats in exactly one place (listener or use case), not both.
status_note: stats updated only in listener; credit use case no longer increments

summary: Tier upgrade loop iterates tiers ordered by sortOrder (not minPoints) reversed and skips the tier equal to current, so a Gold customer (600 pts) falls through to Silver because 'Silver' != 'Gold' and 600>=100 -> customer is DOWNGRADED on every purchase.
fix: Pick the highest tier with minPoints<=totalPoints (sort by minPoints desc, take first) and update only if its name differs from current.
status_note: tierForPoints picks highest reached tier by minPoints

summary: restoreIngredients: recipe.findFirst and stockLevel.findFirst/update/movement.create inside nested loops.
fix: Batch queries as in deduction.
status_note: batched restore from recorded movements

summary: restoreIngredients on void increments stock by current-recipe qty regardless of what was actually deducted (deduction may have been clamped to 0 or recipe changed since sale) and is not idempotent (no check for existing 'void' movement) -> stock inflation on double void event.
fix: Reverse using the ingredientStockMovement rows with referenceId=transactionId/type usage; mark reversal with unique (referenceId, referenceType='void').
status_note: restore reverses recorded usage movements; idempotent via marker

summary: reverseLoyaltyPoints is not idempotent: finds the 'earned' row and decrements customer again on every TransactionVoidedEvent delivery; points/totalSpent can go negative. Reversal logged with type 'redeemed'. Writes not in $transaction.
fix: Check for an existing reversal row for transactionId (unique), use a dedicated 'reversed' type, wrap in $transaction, clamp at 0.
status_note: idempotent, clamped, in $transaction; uses 'adjusted' type (dedicated enum value handed off)

summary: Every sale runs SCAN over the whole Redis keyspace for 6 patterns including global 'staff:leaderboard:*' (all tenants); O(keyspace) per transaction.
fix: Use versioned cache keys per outlet/business (INCR a version key) or tag sets instead of SCAN-based invalidation.
status_note: global staff:leaderboard:* pattern replaced by per-business key; SCAN-based invalidation otherwise unchanged (best effort)

summary: Health/readiness checks omit Redis although BullMQ, held bills and caches depend on it; readiness only pings DB.
fix: Add a Redis ping indicator to /health and /health/ready.
status_note: RedisHealthIndicator (ping with timeout) in /health and /health/ready

summary: parseRows loads the entire workbook and returns every row with no max row/size cap (DoS memory) and throws generic Error (500) for missing sheet.
fix: Enforce max rows (e.g. 5k) and file size before parsing; throw BadRequest/AppError.
status_note: MAX_XLSX_ROWS 5000, 10MB, BadRequest for missing sheet/invalid file

summary: When ES is unavailable flush() returns early and log() keeps pushing to buffer with no cap -> unbounded memory growth; ES requests sent without auth.
fix: Cap buffer (drop oldest) and support ES credentials/API key.
status_note: buffer capped (drop oldest, stderr notice); ES auth (basic/apikey/url creds); test. Also fixed default import of winston-transport that was undefined at runtime

summary: ELASTICSEARCH_URL optional without auth credentials; SERVICE_NAME/INDEX_PREFIX/LOG_LEVEL defaults (53,75,88) read directly from process.env; ES client created without username/password.
fix: Add ES auth env vars and validate when ES logging is enabled.
status_note: ElkLoggerService reads via ConfigService; ES credentials required in production when URL set

summary: WinstonModule is registered but never set as the app logger (no useLogger/WINSTON_MODULE_PROVIDER usage), so logs/error.log and combined.log are never written; Nest Logger goes to default console.
fix: app.useLogger(app.get(WINSTON_MODULE_NEST_PROVIDER)) with bufferLogs, or remove.
status_note: needs main.ts useLogger + AppModule module swap (B1) | resolved via handoff

summary: LoggingModule (ElkLoggerService, RequestContextMiddleware, trace ids) is never imported in AppModule; ELK shipping and X-Trace-Id never happen.
fix: Import it and app.useLogger(ElkLoggerService), or delete.
status_note: LoggingModule fixed but must be imported in AppModule and set as logger (B1) | resolved via handoff

summary: RabbitMQ->RxJS bridge consumes '<queue>.bridge' queues that are never bound to any exchange (setupTopology only binds QUEUE_BINDINGS), and re-emitted ReconstructedDomainEvent never matches listeners' ofType(instanceof) filters, so the reverse bridge can never deliver anything.
fix: Remove the reverse bridge, or bind bridge queues and dispatch by eventName rather than instanceof.
status_note: reverse RabbitMQ->RxJS bridge removed

summary: Retry limit never reached: nack(requeue=true) does not add x-death, so getDeliveryCount returns at most 2 (redelivered flag) and failing messages (limit 3) are requeued forever in a hot loop.
fix: Track attempts in a header by republishing with incremented x-retry-count (or use a delay/retry queue via DLX), then dead-letter after limit.
status_note: retry by re-publishing with x-retry-count after backoff, DLX after limit; test

summary: publishEvent() is never called anywhere; if used it would double-publish to RabbitMQ (publishes to RxJS, which the bridge forwards to RabbitMQ, then publishes again).
fix: Remove publishEvent or have it publish only to RxJS and let the bridge forward.
status_note: publishEvent removed

summary: Queue handler methods are placeholders (log + Promise.resolve) that ack real messages when RABBITMQ_URL is set; nothing is processed.
fix: Implement or remove the handlers and their bindings.
status_note: placeholder handler + bindings removed

summary: Queue handler methods are placeholders (log + Promise.resolve) that ack real messages when RABBITMQ_URL is set; nothing is processed.
fix: Implement or remove the handlers and their bindings.

summary: Queue handler methods are placeholders (log + Promise.resolve) that ack real messages when RABBITMQ_URL is set; nothing is processed.

summary: Routing key 'stock.transfer_completed' and 'order.created' are never produced (domain event is 'stock_transfer.status_changed'; no order.created event exists), so those handler branches are unreachable.
fix: Align routing keys with DomainEvent.eventName values.
status_note: unproduced routing keys removed; remaining keys equal DomainEvent.eventName

summary: Queue customers.loyalty is declared and bound to transaction.created/voided but no handler consumes it; every transaction message accumulates forever (durable, persistent) until RabbitMQ hits memory/disk alarm and blocks publishers.
fix: Remove the binding or register a consumer; set x-max-length/x-message-ttl on queues.
status_note: customers.loyalty (and all consumer-less) bindings removed; queues get x-max-length, DLQ max-length+TTL

summary: subscribe() failure is only logged; bootstrap reports handlers active even if subscription failed.
fix: Propagate the error or mark health unhealthy.
status_note: subscription failures tracked, reported by RabbitMQ health; bootstrap logs real active count

summary: After an unexpected connection close, scheduleReconnect() reconnects but consumers are never re-subscribed (MessageConsumerService.consuming stays true), and if the single reconnect's retries fail status stays 'error' with no further attempts.
fix: On successful reconnect re-run subscriptions; keep retrying with backoff indefinitely.
status_note: subscriptions re-established after reconnect; reconnect retries indefinitely with capped backoff

summary: SentryInterceptor is never registered (no APP_INTERCEPTOR/useGlobalInterceptors) and SentryService is injected nowhere.
fix: Register globally or remove.
status_note: SentryInterceptor deleted

summary: SentryService never initializes the Sentry SDK; with SENTRY_DSN set it logs 'Sentry error tracking initialized' but captureException only writes to local log - no errors reach Sentry.
fix: Integrate @sentry/node (init, captureException) or remove the claim.
status_note: SentryService no longer claims Sentry; warns that SDK is not integrated

summary: Template dir is process.cwd()/src/infrastructure/notifications/email/templates, but the production image only copies dist/ (Dockerfile lines 30-33), so verify-email/receipt/low-stock templates are never found and a bare fallback HTML is sent.
fix: Copy templates as assets into dist (nest-cli assets) and resolve relative to __dirname.
status_note: __dirname template dir + escaped fallback; nest-cli assets handoff

summary: If SMTP_HOST unset, emails (incl. verification) are only logged and reported as sent; SMTP_PORT/USER/PASS/FROM default (lines 38-42,61) to 587/''/''/noreply@tilopos.com. k8s uses SMTP_PASSWORD not SMTP_PASS, so prod silently never sends.
fix: Fail boot in production when SMTP is not fully configured, or return failure to callers.

summary: SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASS default to '' and SMTP_FROM defaults to noreply@tilopos.com silently.
fix: Validate SMTP_* when SMTP_HOST is set.
status_note: SMTP_FROM default removed (required); validation handoff | resolved via handoff

summary: When SMTP_HOST is unset, send() logs '[Mock Email]' and returns success; verification/receipt/report emails silently never sent in production.
fix: Fail fast at boot in production when SMTP is not configured, or throw from send().
status_note: send() throws when SMTP not configured

summary:
Email HTML built with raw interpolation `

${title}

${body}

` where body contains tenant-controlled text (product/outlet names) -> HTML injection/phishing content in emails. Same in email.service.ts:82 fallback.
fix: HTML-escape title/body or render via Handlebars template with {{ }} escaping.

summary: notificationLog.notificationType defaults to 'system_error' when metadata lacks notificationType, mislabeling all other notifications.
fix: Require notificationType in payload.
status_note: log only written with valid notificationType/type; no system_error default

summary: send() catches every error and only logs; callers (stock alerts, etc.) believe delivery succeeded; recipient without email/phone/token silently skipped.

status_note: dispatch() returns DeliveryResult; missing contact -> NO_RECIPIENT failed log

summary: PushService always logs '[Mock Push]' and returns true; all push notifications (low stock alerts etc.) are fake in production.
fix: Integrate FCM (FCM_SERVER_KEY) or disable push channel and surface as unsupported.
status_note: PushService no longer fakes success

summary: WHATSAPP_API_URL defaults to fonnte and WHATSAPP_API_TOKEN to ''; with empty token messages are only logged.
fix: Require token when WhatsApp channel enabled; surface failure.

summary: queueTransaction(...).then() has no catch, so an IndexedDB failure silently loses the sale with no toast. isSubmittingRef is reset in finally (line 167) before the queue promise settles, so a double-tap queues the same sale twice. There is no client idempotency key.

summary: The UI sends an edited unitPrice (item.price) for any item with originalPrice. The price-edit UI is gated only by the business feature flag (cart-panel.tsx:101), not by role, and the backend does not enforce pos_price_editing (S-C3).

summary: A cart-level discount (percentage up to 100% or any fixed amount) is sent without a promotion or voucher reference or any approval step, for any role including CASHIER.

summary: The credit sale sends employeeId: user?.employeeId ?? ''. CreateCreditTransactionDto requires @IsUUID employeeId, so users without an employeeId (e.g. an owner account) always get a 400. The backend should also derive employeeId from the JWT and not trust the body.

summary: shiftsApi.list calls GET /employees/:id/shifts/report. That route has @Roles(MANAGER, OWNER, SUPER_ADMIN), so CASHIER and SUPERVISOR get 403, which is swallowed to []. For managers it returns {shifts:[{shiftId,startTime,endTime,sales,transactions}]} and not the Shift shape (id, startedAt, endedAt, openingCash, ...). endedAt is therefore always undefined, every shift counts as active (line 81), startedAt and openingCash are undefined, and history is empty. GET /employees/:id/shifts returns the correct shape.

summary: All GET /api/* responses (tenant data, customers, reports, /auth/me) are cached in 'tilopos-api-v1' keyed only by URL, never purged (logout does not clear caches). On a shared terminal the next user/tenant gets the previous user's data when offline or on network error.
fix: Do not cache authenticated API responses (or only a whitelist, keyed per user) and clear caches on logout via postMessage.
status_note: sw.js never caches/serves /api/* or /socket.io; logout clears Cache Storage

summary: Cache names are hard-coded v1 and never bumped; precached '/' and '/index.html' plus cacheFirst for all .js/.css means stale shells can persist; navigation responses are cached per URL into STATIC_CACHE without bound (line 128).
fix: Version caches per build (inject hash), prune on activate, cache only index.html for navigations.
status_note: versioned cache (v2), old caches pruned on activate, navigations cache only index.html

summary: caches.match(request) without cacheName searches every cache, so API fallbacks can come from other caches; 503 JSON {error:'Offline'} is returned to axios which the client treats as server error toast, not offline.
fix: Match within the specific cache; return a recognizable offline status/header.
status_note: cache.match scoped to static cache; offline responses carry X-Tilo-Offline header; API not intercepted

summary: registerServiceWorker() is called unconditionally (also in dev) with no callbacks, so update availability and registration errors are silently dropped; users never get a 'new version' prompt.
fix: Register only in production and wire onUpdate to a reload prompt (SKIP_WAITING).
status_note: SW registered only in production with update prompt (SKIP_WAITING + reload) and error logging

summary: Sync endpoint is `${apiBaseUrl}/${entityType}` with apiBaseUrl '/api' (constants/sync.constants.ts:14) => POST /api/transactions, which does not exist (backend is /api/v1/pos/transactions). Also no Authorization header because SyncEngine never passes getAuthToken (sync-engine.service.ts:54-56). Offline sales never reach the server.
fix: Use apiClient base URL + /pos/transactions, pass token getter, map offline payload to CreateTransactionDto.
status_note: executor posts via apiClient transport (same baseURL+Bearer) to /pos/transactions with whitelisted payload

summary: processQueue has no in-flight lock; it is invoked concurrently by the 30s timer, 'online' event, queueOperation, useSync.triggerSync and useOfflinePOS.syncPending. With in-loop retries sleeping up to 7s, the same pending item can be POSTed multiple times; no idempotency key is sent, so sales can be duplicated.
fix: Add a mutex/flag, mark items 'syncing' before sending, send an idempotency key (offline id) honored by the backend.
status_note: processQueue shares one in-flight run; items marked 'syncing' before send; clientTransactionId dedupe; tests added

summary: Default strategy 'server-wins' marks a 409 on a create (offline sale) as resolved/completed and only updates local cache: the local sale is silently discarded.
fix: Never auto-resolve creates; move to 'conflict' and surface to the cashier.
status_note: 409 on create never auto-resolved: item kept as 'conflict' and surfaced with retry/discard

summary: executeWithRetry retries every error (4xx, 401, ConflictError) up to maxRetries with sleeps before handleSyncError; isRetryableError (78-110) checks for '400'/'404' in the message but errors are built from response.statusText (sync-executor:77), so 4xx are treated as retryable. Failed items are then never retried and there is no UI to retry.
fix: Throw typed HttpError with status; skip in-loop retry for non-retryable; add manual retry for 'failed'.
status_note: typed SyncHttpError/SyncNetworkError; no in-loop sleeps; 4xx -> failed, 5xx backoff, network/401 stay pending; manual retry in UI

summary: Client-wins sends header X-Force-Update which no backend endpoint honors; pullChangesFromServer (125) calls /api/<entity>?since= (no v1, no since support); checkServerHealth (199) calls /api/health (real: /api/v1/health).
fix: Remove or point to real endpoints.
status_note: removed X-Force-Update, pullChangesFromServer and /api/health calls

summary: pullChanges/getCached/getAllCached/saveLocal/deleteLocal/clearCache are never called anywhere; products/categories are never cached in IndexedDB, so offline POS has no catalog except via the SW's private API cache.
fix: Wire catalog pull on POS load and read from cache when offline, or delete the unused API.
status_note: unused pull/cache API removed (SW no longer caches API by design); offline catalog relies on in-session query cache

summary: initialize() is called on every useOfflinePOS mount (hooks/use-offline-pos.ts:130), opening a new IDB connection each time without closing the previous; completed queue items are never cleared (clearCompleted unused, sync-queue.service.ts:140).
fix: Make initialize idempotent; periodically clear completed items.
status_note: initialize() idempotent; completed items removed after each run

summary: destroy() removes this.handleOnline/handleOffline but constructor registered anonymous arrow wrappers (line 42-43), so listeners are never removed.
fix: Store bound handlers and remove those.
status_note: bound handlers stored and removed in destroy/teardown

summary: useSyncStatus is unused, non-reactive, and returns a Promise as queueStatus (type lie).
fix: Delete it.
status_note: useSyncStatus deleted

summary: printerService (ESC/POS over Web Serial) and hardware.service.ts (hardwareService, barcode/cash drawer, line 302) are never imported; receipts print only via window.print and the cash drawer never opens.
fix: Integrate into POS checkout or remove.
status_note: printer.service.ts and hardware.service.ts deleted (no importers); POS prints via receipt-html (W1-D)

summary: Queued payload includes id/createdAt/employeeId/shiftId (rejected by forbidNonWhitelisted) and has no idempotency key; the localStorage fallback posts to /api/v1/transactions (line 221, nonexistent; ignores VITE_API_BASE_URL) and non-2xx responses keep the item forever.
fix: Map to CreateTransactionDto, POST /pos/transactions via apiClient, send idempotency key, move 4xx to a failed list with UI.
status_note: payload mapped to CreateTransactionDto whitelist + clientTransactionId/occurredAt; LS fallback goes through same engine; legacy LS queue migrated

summary: pendingCount = pending + failed, but failed items are never retried, so the offline indicator stays non-zero forever with no way to resolve.
fix: Expose failed items and a retry/discard action.
status_note: pendingCount excludes failed; failedItems exposed with retry/discard in OfflineBanner

summary: Errors in the LS fallback sync are swallowed (empty catch) and syncStatus is set to 'idle' even when items failed.
fix: Report per-item failures and set 'error'.
status_note: no swallowed errors; status 'error' when items fail

summary: resolveConflict ignores id and strategy (void id; void strategy) and just re-runs sync; it is not used anywhere, so conflicts marked 'conflict' can never be resolved from the UI.
fix: Implement via ConflictResolverService.applyManualResolution or remove.
status_note: resolveConflict replaced by retryItem/discardItem backed by engine

summary: leaveRoom emits {room:'outlet'} but backend joined the client to 'outlet:<id>' and leaveRoom leaves the raw name, so leaving never works; after outlet change or logout-less user switch the socket keeps receiving the old outlet's events.
fix: Send the resolved room name (outlet:<id>) or have backend resolve like joinRoom.
status_note: useSocket resolves room names like the gateway and leaves the resolved name; ref-counted rooms

summary: joinRoom(`outlet:${id}`) / joinRoom(`business:${id}`) hit backend default case -> room 'outlet:<id>:<businessId>', so the hook never receives transfer events by itself; it also subscribes to both 'transfer:status_changed' and 'inventory:transfer-status-changed' (141-142) which backend emits for the same change, so toasts/callbacks fire twice; its cleanup leaveRoom(`outlet:<id>`) (150) removes the SHARED socket from the real outlet room, breaking notifications/orders/shift hooks until reconnect.
fix: Use joinRoom('outlet'/'business'), listen to one event, and ref-count room membership in socket.util.
status_note: transfer hook joins business room only, listens to one event, dedupes deliveries, ref-counted leave; statuses match backend enum

summary: Backend 'transaction:created' payload is {transactionId,outletId,amount,customerId,occurredOn}; hook reads transactionNumber, totalAmount, employeeName (undefined) and writes them into the transaction store (same in use-realtime-sync.ts:59). Active shift banner/consumers get undefined/NaN amounts.
fix: Use data.amount and fetch number/employee or extend the backend payload; fix TransactionCreatedEvent type (types.ts:91).
status_note: TransactionCreatedEvent matches backend payload; use-realtime-transactions (unused) deleted, realtime-sync invalidates queries

summary: Cleanup leaveRoom(`business:${id}`) removes the shared socket from the business room other consumers may rely on (no ref counting).
fix: Ref-count rooms.
status_note: room membership ref-counted in socket.util

summary: All realtime hooks (orders, inventory, notifications, shifts, transactions, sync) require user.outletId; owners/managers without an assigned outlet (who use ui.store selectedOutletId) get no realtime updates at all.
fix: Use selectedOutletId || user.outletId.
status_note: realtime hooks use selectedOutletId || user.outletId

summary: useRealtimeQueue and useRealtimeShifts (use-realtime-shifts.ts:40) and getSocketState are exported but never used; backend 'user:<id>' notification room is never joined by any client.
fix: Remove or wire up.
status_note: useRealtimeQueue/useRealtimeShifts/getSocketState deleted (+ unused useRealtimeInventory/Transactions)

summary: useRealtimeSync updates order.store / inventory.store / transaction.store, but no UI component reads activeOrders, stockLevels or recentTransactions; the stores (stores/order.store.ts, inventory.store.ts, transaction.store.ts) are effectively dead.
fix: Drop the stores or invalidate React Query caches instead.
status_note: order/transaction/inventory stores deleted; useRealtimeSync invalidates React Query caches

summary: 'shift:started' is broadcast to the whole outlet room; the handler sets currentShift to ANY employee's new shift without checking data.employeeId === user.employeeId, so cashier A's POS adopts cashier B's shift.

status_note: shift:started only adopted when employeeId matches

summary: All errors of GET /employees/shifts/current (network, 500, offline) are swallowed and treated as 'no active shift', blocking the POS and hiding outages.

status_note: only {shift:null} means no shift; other errors keep cached shift and expose shiftError

summary: start/end shift failures show a generic message and drop the backend error (e.g. shift already open, cash mismatch); console.error left in.

status_note: backend error message shown via getErrorMessage; console.error removed

summary: 'Error' / 'Not authenticated' English toasts (also 126) in Indonesian UI; use-transfer-socket toasts mix emoji/English ('Transfer', line 70-105).

summary: useKeyboardShortcuts is a no-op, but use-global-shortcuts.ts defines Ctrl+K/B/P/... and POS shortcuts (features/pos/hooks/use-pos-shortcuts.ts) and a shortcuts help dialog advertises them; none work.

status_note: useKeyboardShortcuts implemented (window keydown, input-aware, F-keys allowed in inputs)

summary: prefetchQuery is called during render (side effect every render); onSort (104-119) calls setSortOrder/setSortBy inside state updaters, which StrictMode double-invokes, making sort toggling erratic.

status_note: TOAST_LIMIT raised to 3

summary: useDynamicPricing/usePricingRulesPreview/usePotentialSavings are only used by components/shared/ProductCardWithDynamicPrice.tsx which itself is never imported.

status_note: only importer is unused components/shared/ProductCardWithDynamicPrice.tsx (not W1-owned); delete both via handoff | resolved via handoff

summary: Unused hooks: use-crud-form.ts, use-list-items.ts, use-delete-handler.ts, use-feature-gate.ts, use-focus-trap.ts, use-previous.ts, use-debounced-value.ts (no importers); use-realtime.ts is a deprecated re-export still used.
fix: Delete or adopt.
status_note: deleted use-crud-form, use-list-items, use-delete-handler, use-feature-gate, use-focus-trap, use-previous, use-debounced-value

summary: logout() (triggered automatically on any 401 by api/client.ts:38) deletes the localStorage offline queue 'tilopos-offline-queue' and tries to delete IndexedDB 'tilopos-sync' (actual DB is 'tilopos-offline'); unsynced offline sales in localStorage are destroyed on session expiry, and it also removes 'tilo-pos-cart' (line 36) destroying held bills.
fix: Never drop unsynced sales on logout; block logout or keep queue keyed per user; delete the right DB only after sync.
status_note: logout never deletes queue/held bills; requestLogout() confirms when unsynced; DB 'tilopos-offline' deleted only when empty (purgeIfEmpty) or discardAll; queue items scoped to owner user

summary: JWT and full user object stored in localStorage (XSS-readable); logout does not revoke server-side, does not clear SW caches or the React Query cache (only login/register call queryClient.clear).
fix: Use httpOnly refresh cookie + in-memory access token; clear caches on logout.
status_note: logout clears Cache Storage and tenant UI settings; token storage/refresh handed off (see F1480)

summary: isTokenExpired decodes the JWT payload with atob(), which throws on base64url characters '-'/'_' (and missing padding); the catch returns true, so valid tokens whose payload contains those chars are treated as expired and AuthGuard logs the user out.
fix: Convert base64url to base64 and pad before atob, or use jwt-decode.
status_note: base64url decode with padding (decodeJwtSegment); test added

summary: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user')) at module init has no try/catch; corrupted value crashes the whole app on load.
fix: Wrap in try/catch.
status_note: stored user parsed in try/catch

summary: taxRate/serviceChargeRate/taxInclusive/brandColor are loaded from device localStorage with defaults (11%, exclusive) and only refreshed when someone opens tax-settings-page; logout does not reset them. Cart totals (cart.store.ts:321) can differ from server-computed totals and leak one tenant's tax config to the next user on a shared device.
fix: Load tax config from the API per outlet on login/POS load; reset on logout.
status_note: usePosTaxConfig loads outlet tax config (GET /settings/outlets/:id/tax, same as backend calc) on POS; resetBusinessSettings on logout

summary: Held bills live only in localStorage (backend /pos/hold and /pos/held-bills exist but are not used here); they are wiped on logout (auth.store.ts:36) and silently after 24h (line 401), and not shared across terminals.
fix: Persist held bills via /pos/hold and /pos/held-bills.
status_note: 2026-10-17: web uses server hold/list/resume/delete with business/outlet scoping, server-priced snapshots, paginated reconciliation and explicit error states. Offline drafts persist locally and retry with stable IDs; atomic Redis claims preserve employee-bound retry receipts on lost responses and reject resurrection. No 24h expiry; legacy ownership is preserved with explicit outlet assignment. Verified with real Redis, tenant policy and web offline/retry tests.

summary: setDiscountPercent does not clamp 0..100; >100 yields discountTotal > subtotal and a negative total (setDiscountAmount clamps, percent doesn't).
fix: Clamp percent to [0,100] and discountTotal to subtotal.

summary: isPathVisible returns true before features load, so FeatureGuard lets users open gated routes (e.g. /kds, /app/tables) during the load window or if the features request fails.

summary: Routes /app/reports and /app/reports/sales (lines 88-89) have no RoleGuard; backend /reports/* is @Roles(owner,manager,supervisor). Cashier/kitchen/inventory reach the pages and every query 403s.
