summary: Route /app/invoices has no RoleGuard; the page calls /reports/invoices, /reports/invoices/transactions and /reports/invoices/items-summary which are @Roles(owner,manager,supervisor).

status_note: invoices=SUPERVISION

summary: Route /app/customers/segments guarded only by FeatureGuard; backend GET /customers/segments(/:segment) is @Roles(owner,manager,supervisor) -> cashier/kitchen/inventory get 403.
fix: Add RoleGuard ['owner','super_admin','manager','supervisor'].
status_note: customers/segments=SUPERVISION

summary: Routes /app/customers/new and /app/customers/:id/edit (lines 72-73) unguarded; backend POST/PUT /customers is @Roles(owner,manager,supervisor) so cashier/kitchen/inventory see a form that always fails with 403.

summary: Routes /app/bundle-packages, /new, /:id/edit (lines 60-62) unguarded; backend GET /bundle-packages is @Roles(owner,super_admin,manager,supervisor) and POST/PUT/DELETE @Roles(owner,super_admin,manager). Cashier/kitchen/inventory get 403 on list; supervisor can open the form but save 403s.

summary: Routes /app/products/new and /app/products/:id/edit (lines 58-59) unguarded; backend POST/PUT /inventory/products is @Roles(manager,owner,inventory). Cashier, kitchen and supervisor can open the product form; save fails 403 (known W-6).

summary: Route /app/import unguarded; backend /inventory/products/import-xlsx* is @Roles(manager,owner,inventory) and /customers/import-xlsx* is @Roles(owner,manager). Cashier/kitchen/supervisor can upload files that 403; inventory role can open customer import that 403s.

summary: Routes /app/promotions/new and /:id/edit (lines 118-119) guarded only by FeatureGuard; backend POST/PUT/DELETE /promotions are @Roles(manager,owner). Cashier/supervisor/kitchen can open the form and edit/delete buttons on the list; all writes 403.

summary: Custom range is sent as customDateRange.from/to.toISOString(), unlike the other reports, which send yyyy-MM-dd. The backend getDateRange does new Date(endDate).setHours(23,59,59) in server time, so the local-midnight instant of the end day (previous day 17:00 UTC) becomes previous-day 23:59 UTC, dropping most of the last day. Also, `enabled` does not wait for both dates in 'custom' mode, so it fires with no dates and the backend silently falls back to this_month. The queryKey uses the Date object.
fix: Use format(date,'yyyy-MM-dd') like sales-report.tsx and gate enabled on dateRange!=='custom' || (from && to).
status_note: reportDateParams: yyyy-MM-dd local dates, enabled waits for complete custom range, queryKey uses strings

The 'Buat Pesanan - Rp X' amount the customer confirms is not what the order records; tax rate ignores the business's configured rate.
fix: Fetch the authoritative total from the server (e.g. a quote endpoint or use grandTotal/subtotal/shippingCost from the checkout response) and use store settings for tax/shipping; never show client-invented fees.
status_note: hardcoded tax/fee removed; subtotal + server grandTotal shown

summary: Variant selection is optional: if a product has variants and the user adds without choosing, variantId is undefined and the server prices at product.basePrice, while required modifier groups (minSelections) are never enforced. ProductDetailModal shows product.price as the price regardless.
fix: Require a variant when product.variants.length>0 (preselect first) and enforce modifier group min/max before enabling add-to-cart.

summary: useStorefront error is ignored; any failure (network, 500) renders 'Toko Tidak Ditemukan' instead of a retryable error.

status_note: 404 vs other errors; ErrorState with retry

summary: Success screen promises 'Notifikasi status pesanan akan dikirim via WhatsApp', but createStorefrontOrder sends no WhatsApp/notification (only KDS event). ETA '45-60 menit'/'20 menit' (line 50) is hardcoded.

summary: instagramUrl/facebookUrl from tenant-controlled store data are placed directly in <a href> without scheme validation; a 'javascript:' URL would execute on a public page once the field mapping is fixed. whatsappNumber is interpolated into the wa.me URL unencoded (line 76).

summary: Icon-only remove button (Trash2) has no aria-label; +/- quantity buttons (lines 33-49) and ProductDetailModal +/- (ProductDetailModal.tsx:138,152) are text '−'/'+' only with no accessible name. CartPanel close button (CartPanel.tsx:38) uses English aria-label 'Close'.

summary: Cart panel and checkout flow (CheckoutFlow.tsx:34) and ProductDetailModal (ProductDetailModal.tsx:37) are hand-rolled overlays: backdrop div onClick without role/keyboard, no focus trap, no Escape handling, no role=dialog/aria-modal.

summary: <label> elements are not associated with inputs (no htmlFor/id) in CustomerInfoForm (lines 25,34,44) and DeliveryMethodSelect textarea labels (DeliveryMethodSelect.tsx:79,92).

summary: English labels 'Delivery'/'Pickup' (lines 46,67), 'Checkout' button (CartPanel.tsx:86), 'Sale' badge (ProductCard.tsx:42) in otherwise Indonesian storefront.

summary: Type predicate `m is {id,name,price,isAvailable}` and the Storefront types (types/online-store.types.ts:20-76) assert fields the backend never returns (compareAtPrice, isAvailable, modifierGroups, sku, stock), hiding the contract mismatch at compile time.

summary: 'Lihat Toko' opens `${VITE_API_BASE_URL}/online-store/s/${slug}` which is the raw JSON API (or, with the '/api/v1' default not applied here, '/online-store/s/slug' which is not a SPA route). The public storefront route is /store/:slug (router.tsx:23). The dialog hint (line 239) shows the same wrong URL.

summary: createStore passes businessId in CreateOnlineStoreRequest but the api wrapper drops it (online-store.api.ts:24-28), which is correct because the backend takes businessId from the JWT; the request type is misleading. Backend POST /online-store/stores body is an inline type with no DTO, so an empty or duplicate slug is not reported as a clear validation error.
fix: Remove businessId from CreateOnlineStoreRequest; show a clear message for a duplicate slug (and add a DTO backend-side).

summary: 'Buat Toko' is shown to every role; backend POST /online-store/stores has only JwtAuthGuard (no @Roles), so a cashier can actually create public storefronts for the business.
fix: Hide the button for non owner/manager and add @Roles(OWNER,MANAGER) to the backend route.
status_note: Buat Toko gated by useHasRole(MANAGEMENT); backend @Roles handoff

summary: Order submission is non-atomic: items are POSTed one by one to /self-order/sessions/:code/items then /submit. If any addItem or submit fails, already-added items stay in the session; the cart is kept and the user retries, re-adding every item -> duplicated dishes on the kitchen order.
fix: Send all items in one request (batch endpoint that replaces session items + submits in a transaction) or clear session items before re-adding; make submit idempotent.
status_note: added lines tracked so retry never re-adds; atomic endpoint handoff

summary: Menu items may have variants (backend getMenu returns variants and price = MIN variant price, self-order.controller.ts:106-113,141) but the UI ignores variants: SelfOrderMenuItem has no variants field, addToCart never sets variantId and use-order.ts:60 never sends it. Orders for variant products are created without a variant while the customer was shown the cheapest variant price.

summary: After a successful submit the backend sets session.status='submitted' (self-order.controller.ts:233-236) but 'Pesan Lagi'/'Lacak Pesanan' just resetOrder() and return to the menu; any further addItem fails with 'Session is not active' (controller:168). SelfOrderSession.status type is 'active'|'closed' (types/self-order.types.ts:6) and the page never checks status.
fix: Check session.status and show a 'pesanan sudah dikirim' state or request a new session; align the status union with the backend.
status_note: non-active session shows closed state; no Pesan Lagi after submit

summary: OrderConfirmation total={cartTotal}, but useOrder's onSuccess callback clears the cart before orderStatus becomes 'success', so the confirmation always shows Total Rp 0. The total is also purely client-computed (sum of displayed prices) and never confirmed by the server.
fix: Capture the total before clearing (or return it from submit), preferably use GET /self-order/sessions/:code/total.
status_note: total from GET /sessions/:code/total kept in useOrder

summary: If the server response lacks orderNumber, a fake `ORD-${Date.now()}` is shown to the customer as their order number.

status_note: missing orderNumber is an error

summary: estimatedTime={15} is hardcoded; 'Lacak Pesanan' (order-confirmation.tsx:93) calls resetOrder() and just returns to the menu - no tracking exists.
fix: Remove the tracking button/ETA or implement a status view backed by the API.
status_note: ETA and fake tracking button removed

summary: 'Menu Populer' section with TrendingUp icon just shows the first N available items in alphabetical API order (comment admits no popularity sorting); also refetches the same menu.
fix: Rename to 'Menu' or back it with real sales ranking; reuse useMenu data.
status_note: fake Menu Populer section deleted

summary: useMenu ignores isError: a failed menu fetch renders 'Tidak ada menu yang ditemukan' (menu-grid.tsx:23). useSession error (network/5xx) renders SessionNotFound 'QR tidak valid' (customer-self-order-page.tsx:108), telling the customer their QR is invalid on a transient error.

status_note: menu/session errors render ErrorState; SessionNotFound only for not-found codes

summary: Public GET /self-order/sessions/:code (self-order.controller.ts:49-58) returns the session with items.include.product:true, i.e. full Product rows (cost price, SKU, internal fields) to anonymous clients; the UI only needs outletId/table name. Also QR session code is the sole secret for adding items/submitting.
fix: Backend: select only needed fields; frontend: type the response narrowly.
status_note: frontend types narrow; backend select change handed off | resolved via handoff

summary: Admin preview outlet Select only ever contains the current outlet (lines 190-194), and the 'QR Code Generator' card is a static placeholder ('akan tersedia setelah fitur meja dikonfigurasi') although POST /self-order/sessions exists (selfOrderApi.createSession is never used).
fix: Load outlets via outletsApi and implement QR generation using createSession/tables, or remove the card.
status_note: placeholder QR card removed; outlet select loads outlets

summary: Icon-only buttons without aria-label: remove item X (line 76), -/+ quantity (85,94) in cart-drawer; add '+' button in menu-grid.tsx:63 and product-recommendations.tsx:103. Clickable Card in menu-grid.tsx:32 and image div in product-detail-modal.tsx:36 use onClick without role/keyboard. Lightbox aria-labels are English ('Close','Previous image', product-lightbox.tsx:25,45,54,73). Category buttons in menu-header.tsx:64 lack aria-pressed.
fix: Add Indonesian aria-labels, make cards buttons (role=button, tabIndex, onKeyDown) and add aria-pressed.
status_note: aria-labels, keyboard cards, aria-pressed, Indonesian lightbox labels

summary: 'item'/'items' English pluralisation in Indonesian UI; lightbox alt 'Image N' (product-lightbox.tsx:34).

summary: SelfOrderMenu (+default export) is not imported anywhere; inline styles, English strings ('Your Order','Place Order','Select variant'), mutates state in updateQuantity (line 69). Already listed in audit medium 'Kode mati'.
fix: Delete the file.

summary: Props tableNumber and customerPhone are never passed (customer-self-order-page.tsx:115-121) though session.tableNumber is available, so table number is never shown.

summary: Form collects address, dateOfBirth and notes but POST /customers accepts only {name,email,phone} (customers.controller.ts:74-117) and PUT /customers/:id passes body to customerRepo.update which only maps name/email/phone/loyalty/isActive (prisma-customer.repository.ts:65-90); mapToRecord doesn't return address/dateOfBirth/notes either. User sees 'berhasil' but these fields are silently discarded and edit form always shows them empty.
fix: Add the fields to a validated Create/UpdateCustomerDto and repository mapping, or remove them from the form.
status_note: Fields removed from form (no silent loss); backend DTO handoff to re-add | resolved via handoff

summary: Empty optional fields are sent as undefined, so a user can never clear email/phone on edit (repo skips undefined).
fix: Send null for cleared fields on update and accept null in the backend DTO.
status_note: Update sends null for cleared email/phone (repo passes null through)

summary: listPaginated sends page/limit/search/sort params but GET /customers ignores query params and returns the full array (customers.controller.ts:64-68). The wrapper fakes a single page (customers.api.ts:18-20): search box and sorting do nothing server-side, and all customers load at once.

status_note: Mobile fetches once and filters locally

summary: GET /customers only returns isActive:true customers (prisma-customer.repository.ts:27), so the 'Nonaktif' badge never appears and deactivated customers disappear with no way to reactivate; mobile dialog even says 'masih dapat diaktifkan kembali nanti' (customers-page.mobile.tsx:256).

summary: Deactivation uses PUT /customers/:id {isActive:false} instead of the existing DELETE /customers/:id soft-delete endpoint (customers.controller.ts:318-326); PUT body is an inline type so any field (loyaltyPoints, totalSpent) is also forwarded to repo.update.

summary: Edit/Hapus row actions, 'Tambah Pelanggan' and 'Import Excel' (lines 112-117, 134-139) are shown to every role; backend POST/PUT/DELETE /customers require OWNER/MANAGER/SUPERVISOR and import requires OWNER/MANAGER. summary: listSegments fabricates createdAt = new Date().toISOString() when absent (always), so the 'Dibuat' column shows today's date for every segment; type falls back to segment code ('returning','at-risk','inactive') not in SEGMENT_TYPE_LABELS so raw codes are shown, and 'Hapus' never shows because type is never 'custom'.

summary: segments and segmentCustomers queries ignore isError: failure shows 'Belum ada segmen' / 'Tidak ada pelanggan yang memenuhi kriteria' (line 399) - e.g. the always-404 view endpoint looks like an empty segment.

summary: usePaginatedList error is not handled; failure renders 'Belum ada pelanggan'. Mobile page (customers-page.mobile.tsx:50) same. customer-form-page.tsx:59 ignores query error on edit, showing an empty form that can overwrite the record.

summary: CustomerCard is a clickable Card (div) with onClick and no role/tabIndex/keyboard handler. Segment rule remove button (customer-segments-page.tsx:326) is icon-only without aria-label.

summary: POST /auth/login returns {requiresMfa:true,mfaToken} for MFA-enabled employees (login.use-case.ts:76-90) but onSuccess assumes LoginResponse and calls setAuth with accessToken=undefined (stored as the string 'undefined' in localStorage), marks the user authenticated and navigates to /app -> every call 401 -> logout loop. There is no MFA step and no /auth/mfa or /auth/callback route in the SPA although the Google OAuth callback redirects there (auth.controller.ts:121-125).

summary: Login (and register-page.tsx:54) persist the JWT via setAuth into localStorage (auth.store.ts:24-27) together with the user object; accessible to any XSS, no refresh/expiry rotation. (Known W-4; exact write sites.)

status_note: Partial remediation 2026-09-30: access token moved to memory; Secure/httpOnly/SameSite refresh cookie, hashed token families, atomic rotation/reuse revocation, server logout, CSRF/origin checks, session bootstrap and single-flight refresh implemented; offline replay bound to original employee. Remains open only for short access-token lifetime: owner explicitly chose to retain current JWT_EXPIRES_IN, so 15m is deferred.

summary: 'Kirim Ulang Email Verifikasi' calls sendVerificationEmail without catch: throttled (3/min) or 401 errors cause an unhandled rejection and no feedback; no loading/disabled state allows repeat clicks.

status_note: useMutation with pending state + error handling

summary: After verification only the local user is updated (emailVerified:true) but the JWT payload still carries emailVerified:false (login.use-case.ts:109) until next login, so any server check on the token claim still treats the user as unverified.
fix: Re-issue the token after verification (return new accessToken) or re-fetch /auth/me.
status_note: web refetches /auth/me; token re-issue needs backend | resolved by counterpart (handoff n/a: already done)

summary: Business-type presets query error is ignored: BusinessTypeStep renders an empty list with 'Lanjut' disabled and no message, blocking registration with no explanation.

summary: role: data.role as 'owner' cast hides that RegisterResponse.role is string; onboardingCompleted hardcoded true and email set to null although account.email is known (also login-page.tsx:28 email:null).

summary: FeatureConfirmStep is not imported anywhere (register flow goes account -> business-type -> business-info).

summary: Category labels 'Food & Beverage', 'Custom' in otherwise Indonesian wizard; taxRate zod error when field is cleared yields default English zod message (business-info-step.tsx:17).

summary: TrustedBySection, PricingSection, TestimonialsSection, FAQSection and DashboardPreview are exported but never used (landing-page.tsx only uses Navigation/Hero/Features/CTA/Footer).

summary: Dead-but-shippable marketing content with fabricated testimonials, fabricated 'Dipercaya oleh' brand list (trusted-by-section.tsx:2: GoFood, BCA, OVO...), fake dashboard numbers (dashboard-preview.tsx), and pricing (pricing-section.tsx: Starter 99.000/Professional 299.000) that contradicts the real plans (Free / Premium 149.000 in pricing-page.tsx & subscription-plans.config.ts). FAQ claims '24/7' support and offline sync that audit W-1 shows is broken.

status_note: fake testimonials/trusted-by/pricing/dashboard-preview deleted

summary: Theme picker buttons (lines 53, 65) are icon/colour-only with only title; mobile menu toggle (line 102) has no aria-label/aria-expanded. Across landing and pricing-page.tsx (lines 73-94,158,218,298) <Link> wraps <Button> producing nested interactive <a><button>.

status_note: aria-label/aria-expanded/aria-pressed; Link>Button replaced with Button asChild across landing & pricing

summary: Billing toggle buttons lack aria-pressed to expose the selected state.
fix: Add aria-pressed={billing==='monthly'} etc. or use a radio group.
status_note: aria-pressed on billing toggle

summary: 'All rights reserved.' English in Indonesian footer (also pricing-page.tsx:328).
fix: 'Hak cipta dilindungi.'
status_note: Hak cipta dilindungi.

summary: Edit promotion always fails: PUT /promotions/:id takes @Body() Record<string,unknown> and passes it straight to prisma.promotion.update (prisma-promotion.repository.ts:68-72). The form sends validFrom/validUntil as 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings (lines 90-91), and Prisma DateTime rejects a date-only string, so the request returns 500.
fix: Send full ISO timestamps (for example new Date(validFrom+'T00:00:00+07:00').toISOString()), and have the backend use a typed UpdatePromotionDto that converts to Date.
status_note: Sends full ISO timestamps (WIB day start/end); backend DTO handoff

summary: Optional fields cannot be cleared on edit. Emptying minPurchase, maxDiscount, usageLimit or description sends undefined, which JSON drops, so the old value stays on the server. Switching discountType away from percentage also leaves the stale maxDiscount.
fix: On update, send null for fields the user emptied, and accept null in the backend update DTO.
status_note: Update sends null for cleared optional fields; maxDiscount null when not percentage

summary: validFrom/validUntil are sent as date-only strings, and the backend does new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') (UTC midnight). A promotion 'valid until 31 Jan' therefore expires at 07:00 WIB on 31 Jan, not at the end of the day. The same applies to voucher validTo (voucher-generator-page.tsx:77-78).
fix: Send end-of-day in Asia/Jakarta for validUntil/validTo, or have the backend normalise with the outlet timezone.
status_note: validUntil/validTo sent as 23:59:59.999 WIB; validFrom 00:00 WIB

summary: The edit-mode query for GET /promotions/:id ignores isLoading and isError. If the fetch fails, the form renders blank and submitting it overwrites the promotion with empty or default values.
fix: Show a loading state and an error state, and disable submit until the promotion has loaded.
status_note: Loading + ErrorState; form not rendered until loaded

summary: The search box sends ?search=, but GET /promotions (promotions.controller.ts:49-53) ignores the query, so the search does nothing. The backend also returns only isActive=true rows, so the 'Nonaktif' status branch (line 49) never renders and deactivated promotions disappear with no way to reactivate them.

status_note: Client-side search; dead Nonaktif branch removed

summary: The Tambah/Edit/Hapus actions (lines 173, 155, 158) show for every role. Backend POST/PUT/DELETE /promotions require MANAGER or OWNER, so cashier and supervisor users hit 403.

status_note: useCan promotions.write hides Tambah/Edit/Nonaktifkan

summary: useQuery isError is not handled. A 500 or network failure renders the 'Belum ada promosi' empty state.

summary: The 'Batas Penggunaan per Voucher' field is misleading. The backend stores usageLimit on the single parent promotion shared by all generated vouchers (promotions.controller.ts:152), while GET /promotions/vouchers hardcodes usageLimit:1 and usageCount 0/1 (lines 119-120). The table's 'x / 1' and 'Habis' status (line 28) do not reflect the value the user entered.

summary: The 'Buat Voucher' form and submit show for all roles, but POST /promotions/vouchers/generate is MANAGER/OWNER only, so cashiers get 403.

status_note: useCan vouchers.generate hides generator form

summary: The voucher list query ignores isError, so an error renders as the 'Belum ada voucher' empty state.

summary: Loyalty program detection is broken. GET /settings/loyalty returns {program:null,tiers:[]} when no program exists (settings.controller.ts:166-171). promotionsApi.getLoyaltyProgram (api/endpoints/promotions.api.ts:50) does `data.program ?? data`, which returns the wrapper object, so loyaltyProgram is always truthy. summary: isProgramError is treated as 'no program': any error, including 403 for cashier/supervisor since /settings/* is OWNER/MANAGER only, shows the 'Belum ada program loyalti' empty state and a 'Buat Program' button that will 403. summary: `row as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).pointMultiplier` and `b as Record<string, number>` (line 104) hide a real type mismatch: the backend tier has pointMultiplier and a JSON benefits field, while LoyaltyTier declares multiplier and benefits:string.

summary: The column headers 'Multiplier' (line 94) and 'Benefits' (line 99) are English in an otherwise Indonesian page.

summary: The submit button's aria-label is English ('Saving changes...' / 'Creating promotion...') in an Indonesian UI.

summary: <Label htmlFor="discountType"> points at nothing because the SelectTrigger (line 145) has no id, so the discount-type select has no accessible label.

summary: PromotionsManager (inline-styled, English UI) is not imported anywhere in packages/web/src (already known in the audit doc, section 3 Medium).

status_note: promotions-manager.tsx deleted

summary: GET /credit-sales/reports/outstanding is MANAGER/OWNER only (credit.controller.ts:101-102), but the page (reachable by cashier/supervisor) calls it unconditionally. On 403 the summary cards silently show 'Total Piutang Rp 0' and '0 pelanggan'. Neither query handles isError, so a list failure shows 'Tidak ada data piutang' (line 258).

summary: getPreviousPeriod builds local-time boundaries (startOfDay, startOfMonth, ...) and then formats them with date.toISOString().split('T')[0], which is UTC. In Asia/Jakarta (UTC+7), local midnight is 17:00Z of the previous day, so every startDate shifts back one day. 'today' compares against the day before yesterday through yesterday (a 2-day window), and last month/week/year start one day early. The dashboard trend % (use-dashboard-data.ts:15) is therefore systematically wrong.
fix: Format with date-fns format(d,'yyyy-MM-dd') (local), or compute in the outlet timezone.

summary: The preset selection cards are toggle buttons with no aria-pressed/role=radio. Selection is conveyed only by border color and a CheckCircle icon.
fix: Use role='radiogroup' plus role='radio' with aria-checked, or add aria-pressed={isSelected}.
status_note: radiogroup/radio aria-checked

summary: The indeterminate prop is broken. checked={indeterminate ? 'indeterminate' : props.checked} is followed by {...props}, which contains checked and overrides it. Callers pass checked={isAllSelected} (false) together with indeterminate (products-page.tsx:143-144, transfers-page.tsx:168), so Radix gets checked=false: aria-checked='false' and no Minus indicator is rendered, while the box is painted bg-primary. Screen readers and sighted users see contradictory states.
fix: Destructure checked out of props and pass checked={indeterminate ? 'indeterminate' : checked} after the spread.
status_note: checked destructured and applied after spread

summary: The prev/next month buttons (lines 107, 117) are icon-only (ChevronLeft/ChevronRight) with no aria-label. Day buttons (148) have no accessible full-date label or aria-pressed/aria-selected for the selected state. The grid has no role=grid or keyboard navigation.
fix: Add aria-label='Bulan sebelumnya'/'Bulan berikutnya', aria-label={format(day,'PPPP',{locale:id})} and aria-pressed={selected}.
status_note: nav aria-labels, day aria-label + aria-pressed

summary: ToastClose is an icon-only X button with no aria-label or sr-only text. It is also opacity-0 until hover, so it is invisible on touch devices.
fix: Add aria-label='Tutup' and make it visible on focus/touch.
status_note: aria-label Tutup; visible on touch/focus

summary: The custom Slider accepts no id or aria-* props and does not spread props onto the <input type=range>. Its only uses (image-cropper-modal.tsx:125,145) sit next to <Label> elements with no htmlFor, so the zoom and rotation sliders have no accessible name.
fix: Spread the rest props (id, aria-label) onto the input, and pass aria-label='Zoom'/'Rotasi'.
status_note: Slider forwards id/aria props

summary: RadioGroupItem renders native radios with no name attribute. Each radio becomes its own group, so arrow-key navigation between options doesn't work and every radio is a separate tab stop.
fix: Put a shared name in RadioGroupContext (useId), or use @radix-ui/react-radio-group.
status_note: shared name via useId

summary: AlertTitle (39) and AlertDescription (52) destructure className but never apply it (eslint no-unused-vars is disabled to hide this). Caller classes are silently dropped, for example transfer-detail-page.tsx:233-234 text colors and report-error-state.tsx:22 'flex flex-col gap-3'. The ref is typed as HTMLParagraphElement but attached to h5/div.
fix: Use className={cn('mb-1 font-medium ...', className)} and remove the eslint-disable comments.
status_note: className applied; ref types fixed; eslint-disable removed

summary: The custom Slot in FormControl clones the child with ref: its own forwarded ref, which replaces the ref react-hook-form passes via {...field} (for example product-form-page.tsx:270-271). RHF's shouldFocusError therefore cannot focus the invalid field after submit. Also, the `if (!fieldContext)` guard (line 40) runs after getFieldState and can never fire, because the context defaults to {}.
fix: Use @radix-ui/react-slot (it composes refs), and check fieldContext.name before use.
status_note: uses @radix-ui/react-slot (composes refs); fieldContext.name checked before use

summary: The screen-reader text of the close buttons is English 'Close' in DialogContent (dialog.tsx:44) and SheetContent (sheet.tsx:64), in an otherwise Indonesian UI.
fix: Change it to 'Tutup'.
status_note: sr-only Tutup in dialog and sheet
